Rating: overstated / not verifiable as claimed NPR's annotated fact-check says damage assessments are uncertain without inspection access and treats "obliterated" as overclaiming certainty and completeness. () FactCheck.org similarly characterizes "obliterated" as stronger than what can be responsibly confirmed from available evidence. () 17) In my first 10 months, I ended eight wars. Rating: exaggerated The Guardian's fact-check summary disputes the count and the definition of "wars," noting some ceasefires were temporary and some situations cited are not typically categorized as wars. () AP likewise treats the claim as inflated in its roundup of misleading statements. () 18) We can balance the budget if we find enough fraud. Rating: false / implausible FactCheck.org argues the scale doesn't work: annual deficit figures are far larger than credible estimates of recoverable fraud. () CBS similarly treats the "fraud alone balances the budget" argument as not adding up when compared with deficit magnitude. () 19) Americans will now pay the lowest price anywhere in the world for prescription drugs (via TrumpRx/MFN framing) Rating: mostly false / overstated NPR's annotated fact-check disputes the "lowest anywhere in the world" claim and describes limitations in scope and how most insured patients pay (copays/coverage dynamics). () FactCheck.org also treats the claim as unsupported at the broad level implied and emphasizes that program constraints undercut the universal phrasing. () 20) Trump accounts could grow to $100,000 by age 18. Rating: highly optimistic Multiple fact-check writeups treat this as a best-case, assumption-heavy projection rather than a likely outcome. ABC News' fact-check package frames similar "could reach" projections as dependent on strong market returns and consistent contributions, making the implied certainty misleading. () FactCheck.org also treats the $100,000 number as not a grounded expectation for typical assumptions. () 21) Unemployment remains low by historical standards. Rating: true Economic reporting confirms the unemployment rate remains relatively low (e.g., ~4.3% in early 2026), indicating a comparatively strong labor market even if job growth has slowed. Reuters data on weekly jobless claims supports labor market stability despite concerns. () 22) The U.S. economy has added jobs in each year of my administration. Rating: true Though job gains slowed in 2025, employment levels continued to rise, consistent with Trump's claim that the net number of jobs did not decline year-over-year. Fact-checkers note job creation continued through 2025, even if slower than prior years. () 23) Border encounters have fallen from recent highs. Rating: true Though Trump's absolute "zero" claim is false, ABC News and other outlets acknowledge that encounters at the U.S. border have dropped significantly from earlier peaks, supporting the basic directional assertion of a reduction. () 24) Service members received the $1,776 'warrior dividend' checks. Rating: true Despite disagreement on the funding source, multiple outlets confirmed that the government disbursed the promised $1,776 payments to eligible military personnel as he described. () 25) "The stock market has seen record highs for major indexes." | | ---|---|--- Rating: true Reuters reported that major U.S. stock indices (including the Dow and S&P 500) reached significant record levels under Trump's second term, which supports his broader point about market performance boosting retirement savings. () 26) He delivered the longest State of the Union address in U.S. history. Rating: true Multiple reports confirm Trump's address on February 24, 2026, lasted about 1 hour and 48 minutes, making it the longest formally designated State of the Union ever recorded, surpassing previous records Stay Angry Join otherANGRY DEMOCRATS** by support Matt's work. Peter,
My name is Mary Peltola, and I want to share with you why I've made the decision to run for the United States Senate in Alaska — and to ask for your support as we begin this journey together.
But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to become a Founding Donor to our campaign, please use this link to split a contribution today:
secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola/founding-donor [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola?refcode=022026_3]
CHIP IN NOW >>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola?refcode=022026_3]
Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.
When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.
Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.
Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.
So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.
And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying 17 bucks for a gallon of milk. They don’t even believe us.
They're focused on their own wallets — not ours.
And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.
It’s why our prices are rising, and our heating bills keep going up. All while the health care and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.
I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.
Systemic change is the only way to bring down grocery costs, save our fisheries, lower energy prices, and build new housing Alaskans can actually afford.
Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.
My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.
But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.
I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.
This is going to be one of the closest Senate races of the next election, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to win this race... and that is together.
So I am asking:
Please contribute to my campaign for the U.S. Senate and Real Texas PAC today to become a Founding Donor. subject: RE: Urgent: Stop the SAVE Act in the Senate
body:
Peter,
The SAVE Act is the largest rollback on voter rights in U.S. history. Have you taken action yet to protect you and your neighbor’s voting rights?
The SAVE Act will make it hard for 21 million Americans to exercise their right to vote. Email your Senator now! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/_iTZp7BTakm3bNgqSA8P2g2]
Take action [https://secure.ngpvan.com/_iTZp7BTakm3bNgqSA8P2g2?contactdata=sCJVoxU9NGKqXE1vJwH9UqXP+tP9LXZq/4CpnOGDFPMwsFND1q+TYWsr3KGSr/1zA/f9CtmVXSX/UP2Q3JeSgQa5rq3I78GQ2AxYqyLq/Wc/a97gwJYIwq2J8M/zGfxZ]
Thank you for your support,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Britney_signature-removebg-preview.png]
Britney VanCitters (she/her)
OLCV Political & Organizing Director
https://secure.ngpvan.com/_iTZp7BTakm3bNgqSA8P2g2?contactdata=sCJVoxU9NGKqXE1vJwH9UqXP+tP9LXZq/4CpnOGDFPMwsFND1q+TYWsr3KGSr/1zA/f9CtmVXSX/UP2Q3JeSgQa5rq3I78GQ2AxYqyLq/Wc/a97gwJYIwq2J8M/zGfxZ [https://secure.ngpvan.com/_iTZp7BTakm3bNgqSA8P2g2?contactdata=sCJVoxU9NGKqXE1vJwH9UqXP+tP9LXZq/4CpnOGDFPMwsFND1q+TYWsr3KGSr/1zA/f9CtmVXSX/UP2Q3JeSgQa5rq3I78GQ2AxYqyLq/Wc/a97gwJYIwq2J8M/zGfxZ]
Hi Peter,
We need your help to stop the dangerous SAVE Act from passing the U.S. Senate.
Congressional Republicans announced plans to renew their efforts to pass the anti-voter SAVE Act, even going so far as to introduce new SAVE Act bills under new names, essentially SAVE 2.0.
But we’re not fooled by this latest attempt to trick us into making it harder for millions of eligible voters to cast their ballot. To stop this bill in its tracks, we need to flood the phone lines of our Senators with our vocal opposition to SAVE and SAVE 2.0.
Email your Member of Congress today and tell them to vote NO on the SAVE Act! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/_iTZp7BTakm3bNgqSA8P2g2]
If passed, the SAVE Act would require every single American citizen to provide either a passport or an original copy of their birth certificate when registering to vote, and anytime they update their voter registration. Do you know where the original copy of your birth certificate is?
Exactly – the problem is that 21 million American citizens don’t have these documents readily available.
This bill would especially burden military voters, tribal voters, rural voters, survivors of natural disasters, communities of color, and married women who have changed their last names.
Tell Congress to vote NO! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/_iTZp7BTakm3bNgqSA8P2g2?contactdata=sCJVoxU9NGKqXE1vJwH9UqXP+tP9LXZq/4CpnOGDFPMwsFND1q+TYWsr3KGSr/1zA/f9CtmVXSX/UP2Q3JeSgQa5rq3I78GQ2AxYqyLq/Wc/a97gwJYIwq2J8M/zGfxZ]
That’s why we need to take action today: Email your Member of Congress and tell them to vote NO on the SAVE Act. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/_iTZp7BTakm3bNgqSA8P2g2]
Thank you for standing up for democracy,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Britney_signature-removebg-preview.png]
Britney VanCitters (she/her)
OLCV Political & Organizing Director

I’m not going to stay silent while the most powerful man lies about my community
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2107%2E791427%2E1mq50N)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260225-1-subs&t=2&akid=2107%2E791427%2E1mq50N)
Friend, I got into it with the President last night.
**I’m not going to stay silent while the most powerful man lies about my community and spreads even more fear and hatred.**
The truth is simple: Donald Trump has killed innocent Americans. Two of them were my constituents. Their names are Alex Pretti and Renee Good.
But those names did not come out of the President's mouth last night. **Because he is a coward.**
Trump should be ashamed of himself — him and the entire Republican Party have no empathy for their fellow Americans. They don’t care that ICE murdered two citizens in cold-blood; that’s just collateral damage to them as they pursue their violent agenda of brutal crackdowns, mass detention, and deportation.
**[If you’re with me in the fight to defeat these cowardly fascists and turn back the clock on their destructive agenda, please rush a contribution to power our movement today >>](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260225-1-subs&t=3&akid=2107%2E791427%2E1mq50N)**
**[RUSH A DONATION](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260225-1-subs&t=4&akid=2107%2E791427%2E1mq50N)**
Last night, I spoke up with fire in my heart. **Because I’m angry as hell.**
ICE swooped into my community based on a lie; that the Somali-American community is collectively guilty for the actions of a small few. That the very existence of people who look like me and share my story are not acceptable in Trump’s America.
**They used this lie to unleash absolute chaos.**
ICE agents all but suspended civil rights in their pursuit of deportations. Anyone with an accent or a different skin color was stopped in the street or in their cars and racially profiled. Homes were violently entered without proper warrants. Everyone from refugees to legal residents to US citizens were swept up in illegal detentions.
When protesters and observers mobilized to fight back, ICE responded with unprecedented brutality. Ramming into civilian cars. Beating protesters with steel batons. Throwing innocent people to the ground. Ripping people from their vehicles through shattered glass. Tear-gassing and pepper-spraying babies, children, pregnant women, and the elderly. Shooting two innocent people dead in the street, with more injured.
**What ICE did in Minnesota lays bare the sheer cruelty, violence, authoritarianism, and incompetence of Trump’s administration.**
But now, it’s our time. Our time to raise our voices high, even when the President is speaking. Our time to fight back and defend basic American values of freedom and justice. Our time to defeat the MAGA far-right so we can pursue a truly progressive agenda that leaves no Americans behind.
**[Friend — I need you with me if we’re going to win. Please, chip in whatever you can afford today and supercharge our movement to defeat Trump and his MAGA army so we can restore sanity and progress to these United States. I am sick and tired of the lies, the violence, and the corrupt. Friends—
The first Emerge win of 2026 is already making an impact.
Elizabeth Bennett-Parker has won her race for Virginia’s 39th Senate District — and with it, she didn’t just hold a seat.
This one is especially personal for me — this is my home district, and now my governor, mayor, and state senator are all Emerge alums. I am proud that Emerge’s work played a part in building a better community for my friends and neighbors.
With this win, she helped maintain a 21–19 Democratic majority in the chamber - a margin will shape what’s possible in Virginia this year.
And here’s what makes this win even more powerful:
When she’s sworn in, Bennett-Parker will become the sixth Emerge Virginia alum serving in the 40-member Senate. For the first time, more than half of the women in the Democratic caucus are Emerge alums.
This is what building a pipeline looks like.
Bennett-Parker is part of Emerge Virginia’s Class of 2017 — a class that also produced Governor Abigail Spanberger. That same cohort is now helping lead at every level of government.
We don’t just train candidates for one race. We build leaders who shape the future for years to come.
And it’s working.
From city councils to statehouses to governors’ mansions, Emerge women are stepping up, running strong campaigns, and delivering results for their communities.
But none of this happens without you.
If you’re ready to help power the next wave of women leaders, will you contribute to Emerge today?
Every dollar you give helps recruit, train, and support women who are ready to run — and win.
Because victories like this don’t happen by chance.
They happen because people like you invest in them.
Let’s keep going,
- A'shanti Gholar

Most people think the biggest challenge in a job search is the interview.
But today, millions of working people may never even get that far.
Before a human ever sees their resumé, a hidden algorithm may decide whether they’re worthy of moving forward: scoring them, ranking them, and quietly shutting the door, sometimes based on information about them that’s been scraped from the internet.
That’s why David and his team just filed this groundbreaking, first-in-the-nation case against an AI company that allegedly uses hidden algorithms to help decide who gets a job and who doesn’t.

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: What I took from the State of the Union
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Powered by People, [poweredxpeople
body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240709%2E444211%2EAg-XwH)
After last night’s State of the Union, there was nothing to give one hope or confidence in the future of our country. No shred of dignity left in this administration, nothing that looked like representative democracy in the chamber.
Why did Democrats show up? Why give this production any veneer of legitimacy as Trump basked in glowing ovations from Republican members, wrapped himself in glory earned by veterans and the Olympic hockey team and treated this once-historic ceremony as he would a campaign rally with all its oratorical onanism, racism and constant baiting of those he defines as national enemies, whether they’re immigrants or Democrats.
Congress looked as weak and slavish last night as they’ve acted throughout this past year. Trump’s hold on the Republicans is complete. Desperate corndogs tried to snap selfies as he walked in, standing on reflex at the end of every other sentence of his speech, not so much reacting to his words as responding to the strings he pulled from the lectern. Master of puppets. The Democrats, some looking at their phones, others yelling unheard at the President, all of them sitting through his taunts and lies, trying to decide for what they could stand and applaud, were impotent in their minority. This was the least co-equal looking branch I’ve ever seen.
Equally miserable, John Roberts and the Court maintained their silently sober, dour disposition throughout. They may have checked him on tariffs, but his shredding of the Constitution, his defiance of the rule of law, his open corruption will be met by this same silence for the remainder of his term.
The one thing I could take from yesterday’s spectacle, the only thing, was the urgency of the moment for all of us who believe in America. Every minute of the address reinforced the fact that we must act now if we hope to save the country from this petty would-be dictator.
As he attempts to rally his side to a new war of choice in Iran, as he seeks to work outside of the Constitution to further enrich himself and insulate himself from justice (Epstein and otherwise), as he threatens to take the right to vote from millions of Americans and attempts to steal the 2026 midterms before the first vote is cast, we cannot expect Congress to stand up for us. We cannot hope that the Court will intervene.
All of this was true before last night. But there was something about watching this grotesque pageant conducted in the heart of what was once the world’s greatest democracy, something about knowing that tens of millions of my fellow Americans saw this live with me, something about the smug confidence of Trump and the pets at attention behind him—a smugness that said despite our corruption and crimes, despite our deep unpopularity, we will never face justice or accountability from the voters—that made it all too clear what we are up against and what will happen unless there is an exceptionally vigorous and aggressive and _successful_ fight against this growing tyranny from the people of this country.
That means protests in the streets, the biggest the country has ever seen. The upcoming [**No Kings protests**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67577?t=3&akid=240709%2E444211%2EAg-XwH) in March are a good place to start, and you can find other national and local ones through [**Mobilize**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67578?t=4&akid=240709%2E444211%2EAg-XwH).
That means donating to the Democratic candidates who can win a majority in the House and the Senate. While some primaries are still in play (Texas), there are Democratic Senate nominees who could use your help right now:
* [**Jon Ossoff in Georgia**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67480?utm_source=ema20260225-240709&t=5&akid=240709%2E444211%2EAg-XwH)
* [**Roy Cooper in North Carolina**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67481?utm_source=ema20260225-240709&t=6&akid=240709%2E444211%2EAg-XwH)
* [**Sherrod Brown in Ohio**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67482?utm_source=ema20260225-240709&t=7&akid=240709%2E444211%2EAg-XwH)
* [**Mary Peltola in Alaska**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67483?utm_source=ema20260225-240709&t=8&akid=240709%2E444211%2EAg-XwH)

That means volunteering, because voting is not going to be enough. Join an organization that is registering voters or helping those targeted for suppression or intimidation or focusing on turnout among under-invested constituencies. Powered by People is focused on doing all of this in Texas and you can join here:
[**https://poweredxpeople.org**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/64245?source=ema20260225-240709&t=9&akid=240709%2E444211%2EAg-XwH)
That means doing all you can with what you have wherever you are in this country, now and every day going forward.
Last night was a spur to greater urgency and greater action. No one—not the Congress, not the Courts, not the traditional centers of power—is going to do it for us. It’s on all of us to reject the insanity on display, to work together to build power, and then use it to save this country while we still can.
Thank you,
Beto

subject: What we are capable of at our best
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Hundreds of young athletes showed us teamwork and resilience, but also the value of sacrifice and the strength of our diversity.
#

Folks, it's Mark.
Writing to you this morning after trying to digest the State of the Union Trump delivered last night. Like many of you, it left me pretty frustrated.
After a year in office, Trump has increased his personal wealth by more than $3 billion. We’ve never seen anything like it in the history of our country. The corruption alone is staggering.
That personal grift and corruption come alongside arguably the most direct effort to undermine the Constitution by any President, ever. He’s tried to use an authoritarian playbook and attacked or prosecuted anyone who has stood in his way.
I’ve experienced that personally, but this is about more than just me. The President of the United States is coming for the Constitutional rights of every American — from journalists to doctors and teachers. It’s against everything this country stands for.
If you watched any of the Olympics over the last few weeks, you saw what we’re capable of at our best. Hundreds of young athletes showed us teamwork and resilience, but also the value of sacrifice and the strength of our diversity.
It made me incredibly proud, because that’s the United States of America. That’s what we are. I’m going to hang on to that, because I know we’re in for the fight of our lives this year.
I will not back down. And if you are with me, please:

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. | | _**_A Personal Note from Senator Ted Cruz_**_ Fellow Conservative, I'll keep this note straight to the point because we don't have much time left. **_For the _second month in a row_ , we are now on the cusp of MISSING our fundraising goal for the critical end-of-month deadline in an election year!_** This does not bode well for the midterms... Frankly, it fits the same pattern we've seen since the beginning of last year. Ever since we took back the White House and the Senate, Democrats have been energized and mobilizing and Republicans have been sitting on the sidelines. _We 're seeing it in elections, we're seeing it in our voter verification numbers, we're seeing it in our fundraising, and _we 're even seeing it in the number of conservatives reading our emails_!__ _ But you're among the few % who opened. And I'm not surprised, because your record shows you're a TOP supporter, so you're among the few I can count on to read this email from start to finish, Fellow Conservative. **To be fully transparent - I don't have any checks left to cash or large pledges. Unlike the Democrats, I don't have left-wing mega-donors I can call up to bankroll our grassroots campaign. ** At this make-or-break moment, grassroots supporters like _YOU_ are _truly_ the last place left for me to turn. _In fact, just one month ago, YOU pulled through for us at the final hour_. With time running out, I have no choice but to ask for your support one final time. _(I understand that things are still tough as we recover from four years of Biden 's economy. If you're not in the position to donate right now - or if you've already given all that you can - please disregard what I'm about to ask. I mean it!)_ **But otherwise, please rush an urgent contribution of ANY amount - even just $10 if that's all you can spare - to help us reach our goal before the end-of-month deadline. [[link]](https://trk.email.tedcruz.) **

I know you might be thinking: _Chris, what difference could just $1 really make in a race this competitive?_
Honestly, I get it—$1 doesn’t sound like much. It’s not even a cup of coffee these days (thanks, Trump). But here’s the truth: most people can’t afford to drop $50 or $100 on a political campaign, and I don’t expect them to.
Unlike a lot of politicians who are like pigs at the trough with corporate money, I refuse to play that game. I don’t take corporate PAC money—so I’m relying on this people-powered team to help me keep up my fight in the House.
**What makes our campaign strong is that thousands of people give what they can. And when more and more people chip in, those single dollars add up to something powerful. We proved it in 2024!**
Pennsylvania is one of the toughest battlegrounds in the country, and I was one of the most heavily targeted incumbents. But thanks to thousands of grassroots supporters pitching in whatever they could, we didn’t just win—we expanded our margin of victory from 2022.

| | Peter,

My name is Katie Britt, and if it’s alright with you, I’d like to share a little about who I am. **I’m not part of the D.C. cocktail circuit, and I never will be._That’s just not who I am._**

In 2022, I was elected to represent the great state of Alabama in the United States Senate. I became the first woman in Alabama’s history to hold this seat—but that’s not why I ran.

I ran because I’m a _**mom**_ , a _**wife**_ , and a _**conservative**_ who’s fed up with the direction this country is heading. I came to Washington to fight for our families, to protect our values, and to bring some Alabama backbone to a broken system.

I didn’t come here to make friends with the political elite. I came here to stand up for the people who don’t have a voice in the room—and I’m not backing down.

clean_body: | | | | | Peter, My name is Katie Britt, and if it’s alright with you, I’d like to share a little about who I am. I’m not part of the D.C. cocktail circuit, and I never will be.That’s just not who I am. In 2022, I was elected to represent the great state of Alabama in the United States Senate. I became the first woman in Alabama’s history to hold this seat—but that’s not why I ran. I ran because I’m a mom , a wife , and a conservative who’s fed up with the direction this country is heading. I came to Washington to fight for our families, to protect our values, and to bring some Alabama backbone to a broken system. I didn’t come here to make friends with the political elite. I came here to stand up for the people who don’t have a voice in the room—and I’m not backing down. Before coming to the Senate, I served as the first female president and CEO of the Business Council of Alabama, and before that, I was Chief of Staff to Senator Richard Shelby. I’ve never shied away from a challenge—and I’ve never forgotten who I’m fighting for. In every role I’ve held, my mission has been the same: deliver real results for Alabama families and the American people. Before starting my career in public service, I earned my undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Alabama. That experience taught me how to lead, think on my feet, and fight for what I believe in—and it laid the foundation for everything I’ve done since. But long before that, I was just a small-town girl from Enterprise, Alabama. My dad ran the local hardware store. My mom taught dance to almost every kid in town. We didn’t grow up with wealth or political connections. We came from hard work, grit, and doing things the right way.That’s how I was raised, and that’s exactly how I lead. My husband Wesley and our two amazing kids are my rock. In 2011, a tornado tore through our home and nearly took our lives. That moment changed everything, and reminded me what truly matters. Faith , family , and resilience. I’ve lived a life full of hard work, determination, and breaking barriers. There have been challenges and triumphs alike, but I wouldn’t trade any of it. My story is a testament to what America stands for—the American Dream. From a small town in Alabama, I rose to become my state’s U.S. Senator—a woman who’s breaking barriers and fighting for conservative values every day. I’m living proof of the limitless opportunity and freedom that define this country. But, I didn’t get here by playing it safe or staying quiet, and I’m not about to start now. I’m fighting tooth and nail to keep up and push back hard, for Alabama, for our values, and for every American who believes in freedom. body:
Let’s state facts.
#

Friends,
We need to state facts, because it’s clear that Donald Trump won’t.
Last night during his State of the Union Speech, President Trump falsely took credit for lowering murder rates.
Here’s what Trump won’t tell you: During his first term in office, he oversaw a 37% spike in gun homicides. Crime trends were already declining after he left office the first time. Now, he is trying to defund and disband the same policies he cheered on last night.
**Here’s what Trump has ACTUALLY done:**
🛑 Effectively legalized machine guns
🛑 Slashed funding & staffing for law enforcement
🛑 Made it easier for criminals to access guns
🛑 Put gun industry CEO profits ahead of your family's safety
The gun lobby still has an iron grip on Washington. Too many of our politicians are refusing to pass commonsense gun legislation in exchange for fat checks from the gun lobby.
That is unacceptable. If politicians refuse to protect our communities, then we must repeal and replace them with leaders who will.

subject: My exchange with the President last night →

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260225-1-io.8WunUa&refcode=em20260225-37500&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37500%2E1203867%2EABVXfz ]Tweet by CSPAN: President Trump: “You should be ashamed of yourself.”
Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-MN): “You have killed Americans.” #SOTU #SOTU2026

Peter, I got into it with the
President last night.

I’m not going to stay silent while the most powerful man lies about my
community and spreads even more fear and hatred.

The truth is simple: Donald Trump has killed innocent Americans. Two of
them were my constituents. Their names are Alex Pretti and Renee Good.

But those names did not come out of the President's mouth last night.
Because he is a coward.

Trump should be ashamed of himself — him and the entire Republican Party
have no empathy for their fellow Americans. They don’t care that ICE
murdered two citizens in cold-blood; that’s just collateral damage to them
as they pursue their violent agenda of brutal crackdowns, mass detention,
and deportation.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260225-1-io.8WunUa&refcode=em20260225-37500&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=37500%2E1203867%2EABVXfz ]If you’re with me in the fight to defeat these cowardly fascists and
turn back the clock on their destructive agenda, please rush a
contribution between my campaign and Justice Democrats to power our
movement today >>

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260225-1-io.8WunUa&refcode=em20260225-37500&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=37500%2E1203867%2EABVXfz ]RUSH A DONATION

Last night, I spoke up with fire in my heart. Because I’m angry as hell.

ICE swooped into my community based on a lie; that the Somali-American
community is collectively guilty for the actions of a small few. That the
very existence of people who look like me and share my story are not
acceptable in Trump’s America.

They used this lie to unleash absolute chaos.

ICE agents all but suspended civil rights in their pursuit of
deportations. Anyone with an accent or a different skin color was stopped
in the street or in their cars and racially profiled. Homes were violently
entered without proper warrants. Everyone from refugees to legal residents
to US citizens were swept up in illegal detentions.

When protesters and observers mobilized to fight back, ICE responded with
unprecedented brutality. Ramming into civilian cars. Beating protesters
with steel batons. Throwing innocent people to the ground. Ripping people
from their vehicles through shattered glass. Tear-gassing and
pepper-spraying babies, children, pregnant women, and the elderly.
Shooting two innocent people dead in the street, with more injured.

What ICE did in Minnesota lays bare the sheer cruelty, violence,
authoritarianism, and incompetence of Trump’s administration.

But now, it’s our time. Our time to raise our voices high, even when the
President is speaking. Our time to fight back and defend basic American
values of freedom and justice. Our time to defeat the MAGA far-right so we
can pursue a truly progressive agenda that leaves no Americans behind.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260225-1-io.8WunUa&refcode=em20260225-37500&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1005&akid=37500%2E1203867%2EABVXfz ]Peter — I need you with me
if we’re going to win. Please, chip in whatever you can afford today,
split between me and Justice Democrats, and supercharge our movement to
defeat Trump and his MAGA army so we can restore sanity and progress to
these United States. I am sick and tired of the lies, the violence, and
the corruption. Let’s fight back and WIN.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260225-1-io.8WunUa&refcode=em20260225-37500&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1024&akid=37500%2E1203867%2EABVXfz ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260225-37500-footer&t=1025&refcode2=37500_1203867_ABVXfz&akid=37500%2E1203867%2EABVXfz

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. # [Trump declares "turnaround for the ages" in marathon SOTU](https://substack.com/redirect/7bbbac16-033e-466c-b480-28864370da43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Donald Trump **[hailed a dramatic"turnaround for the ages"](https://substack.com/redirect/7bbbac16-033e-466c-b480-28864370da43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in his first State of the Union address of his second term Tuesday night, touting sharp drops in inflation to 1.7%, gasoline prices below $2.30 a gallon, border security gains, and tax breaks like no tax on tips or overtime after just one year back in office, while issuing sharp warnings about prior failures and clashing with disruptive Democrats in a record-long speech lasting nearly two hours.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7bbbac16-033e-466c-b480-28864370da43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Economic triumph touted** : Trump claimed core inflation fell to its lowest in over five years at 1.7% in late 2025, with everyday Americans like a homeschooling waitress saving thousands via no-tax policies on tips, overtime, and expanded child credits.
* **Border and security focus** : He emphasized zero recent illegal crossings, highlighted victims of migrant crime as guests, and challenged Democrats to affirm protecting citizens over non-citizens, sparking seated refusals and outbursts.
* **Heroism honors awarded** : Trump presented Medals of Honor to veterans including a 100-year-old WWII aviator and a soldier who participated in Maduro's capture, plus Purple Hearts and other recognitions amid stories of sacrifice and rescue during crises.
* **Future golden age vision** : Looking to America's 250th independence anniversary, he declared a "golden age" underway with promises of bolder progress, energy independence, and a continuing revolution of liberty.

**[Significant takeaways from Trump's speech:](https://substack.com/redirect/145319ce-d761-4157-823e-1674066699d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Universal 401(k) Push** : Trump proposed government matching up to $1,000 yearly **for workers lacking employer retirement plans,** extending benefits to everyday Americans via existing tax credits starting 2027.
* **Corporate Home Ban Call** : He urged Congress to permanently prohibit private equity and institutions from buying single-family homes, prioritizing people over corporations to boost affordability.
* **Inflation Victory Claimed** : Trump asserted core inflation hit its lowest in over five years at 2.5%, crediting his policies for economic strength despite voter skepticism and midterm pressures.
* **Minimal Foreign Focus** : The speech stayed mostly domestic with brief Iran diplomacy comments, avoiding deeper foreign policy while highlighting tensions like Democratic disruptions in the chamber.

# [JPMorgan admits debanking Trump after Jan 6 riot](https://substack.com/redirect/aa15651c-2ade-4a3f-9939-3d3df7855599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
JPMorgan Chase has **[admitted in court filings that it closed bank accounts](https://substack.com/redirect/aa15651c-2ade-4a3f-9939-3d3df7855599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** tied to President Donald Trump and his affiliated companies in February 2021, weeks after the Jan. 6 Capitol riot, amid Trump's $5 billion lawsuit accusing the bank of politically motivated "debanking" that disrupted his business operations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aa15651c-2ade-4a3f-9939-3d3df7855599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Admission in Court** : JPMorgan confirmed via executive declaration that it notified Trump and his hospitality firms in February 2021 of account closures, providing until April to transfer hundreds of millions in funds.
* **No Explicit Reason Given** : Closure letters cited general rights under account agreements to end relationships, with no specific cause listed, though bank policies allow terminations for regulatory or risk concerns.
* **Bank Denies Politics** : JPMorgan insists closures were not due to political or religious reasons but to manage legal and regulatory risks, calling the lawsuit meritless while supporting anti-weaponization efforts.
* **Lawsuit Seeks Justice** : Trump's team views the admission as proof of unlawful discrimination based on conservative views, claiming massive financial and reputational damage in a case demanding a jury trial.

# [Hegseth ultimatum shocks AI giant Anthropic](https://substack.com/redirect/b035d160-5baa-47dc-a9f1-587c9cac265c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Defense Secretary **[Pete Hegseth gave Anthropic until Friday](https://substack.com/redirect/b035d160-5baa-47dc-a9f1-587c9cac265c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to drop safeguards barring its AI from autonomous weapons and mass surveillance of Americans, threatening to blacklist the company or seize control via the Defense Production Act.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b035d160-5baa-47dc-a9f1-587c9cac265c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Deadline looms Friday:** Hegseth issued a firm deadline after Tuesday's tense meeting with CEO Dario Amodei, demanding unrestricted military access to Claude AI models or face severe penalties.
* **Ethical red lines hold:** Anthropic refuses to allow its technology for fully autonomous lethal weapons or widespread domestic spying on U.S. citizens, citing risks of abuse.
* **Threats escalate dramatically:** Non-compliance could trigger a "supply chain risk" label--typically for foreign threats--forcing DoD vendors to avoid Anthropic--or invocation of the Defense Production Act.
* **High stakes for Anthropic:** The clash jeopardizes a $200 million DoD contract and classified network access, despite the company's recent $30 billion valuation and national security role.

# Gold surges amid tariff chaos and Mideast flare-up
Gold **[climbed as much as 1.3% Wednesday, reclaiming ground above $5,000](https://substack.com/redirect/26aba1e3-701a-4f72-bb6d-6e5d73c700ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** an ounce, as investors sought safe-haven protection from fresh uncertainty over U.S. import tariffs--including a new 10% levy--and escalating Middle East tensions ahead of U.S.-Iran nuclear talks.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/26aba1e3-701a-4f72-bb6d-6e5d73c700ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Tariff uncertainty boosts:** Traders eye Trump's 10% import tax effective Tuesday and potential 15% hike, fueling concerns over trade policy chaos and U.S. budget deficit impacts.
* **Geopolitical risks rise:** Middle East frictions intensify with U.S. military buildup before Iran nuclear negotiations, adding to gold's safe-haven appeal.
* **Silver surges sharply:** The white metal jumped above $90 an ounce, riding the wave of broader precious metals demand amid global uncertainties.
* **Analysts see upside:** Experts note tariff and Iran risks could trigger a sustained gold breakout, despite headwinds from steady U.S. interest rates.

# [Bitcoin surges past 66K in dramatic rebound](https://substack.com/redirect/ae8c14b5-a20d-4a3e-87b9-dcf1c37ecaaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Bitcoin briefly topped $66,000 on February 24, 2026, **[rebounding sharply from recent selloffs](https://substack.com/redirect/ae8c14b5-a20d-4a3e-87b9-dcf1c37ecaaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** amid dip-buying and rising equities ahead of President Trump's State of the Union address, though gains pared as the speech avoided crypto mentions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae8c14b5-a20d-4a3e-87b9-dcf1c37ecaaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Dip-buying sparks rally** : Traders scooped up Bitcoin after an extended selloff triggered by tariff policy setbacks, driving a 3.52% intraday gain--the largest since mid-February.
* **Altcoins join surge** : Ether climbed as much as 4.84% to near $1,900, Solana gained up to 5.48%, and XRP rose 3.53% amid broader positive sentiment before partial pullbacks.
* **Trump speech impact** : Crypto trimmed gains during the address defending economic policies, with no mention of digital assets despite his pro-crypto reputation since returning to the White House.
* **Cautious market signals** : Heavy put option buying near $58,000 for early March expiry reflects downside fears tied to geopolitical risks like potential US-Iran tensions.

Defense Secretary to drop safeguards barring its AI from autonomous weapons and mass surveillance of Americans, threatening to blacklist the company or seize control via the Defense Production Act. | | ---|---|--- Deadline looms Friday: Hegseth issued a firm deadline after Tuesday's tense meeting with CEO Dario Amodei, demanding unrestricted military access to Claude AI models or face severe penalties. Ethical red lines hold: Anthropic refuses to allow its technology for fully autonomous lethal weapons or widespread domestic spying on U.S. citizens, citing risks of abuse. Threats escalate dramatically: Non-compliance could trigger a "supply chain risk" label--typically for foreign threats--forcing DoD vendors to avoid Anthropic--or invocation of the Defense Production Act. High stakes for Anthropic: The clash jeopardizes a $200 million DoD contract and classified network access, despite the company's recent $30 billion valuation and national security role. Gold surges amid tariff chaos and Mideast flare-up Gold an ounce, as investors sought safe-haven protection from fresh uncertainty over U.S. import tariffs--including a new 10% levy--and escalating Middle East tensions ahead of U.S.-Iran nuclear talks. | | ---|---|--- Tariff uncertainty boosts: Traders eye Trump's 10% import tax effective Tuesday and potential 15% hike, fueling concerns over trade policy chaos and U.S. budget deficit impacts. Geopolitical risks rise: Middle East frictions intensify with U.S. military buildup before Iran nuclear negotiations, adding to gold's safe-haven appeal. Silver surges sharply: The white metal jumped above $90 an ounce, riding the wave of broader precious metals demand amid global uncertainties. Analysts see upside: Experts note tariff and Iran risks could trigger a sustained gold breakout, despite headwinds from steady U.S. interest rates. Bitcoin briefly topped $66,000 on February 24, 2026, amid dip-buying and rising equities ahead of President Trump's State of the Union address, though gains pared as the speech avoided crypto mentions. | | ---|---|--- Dip-buying sparks rally : Traders scooped up Bitcoin after an extended selloff triggered by tariff policy setbacks, driving a 3.52% intraday gain--the largest since mid-February. Altcoins join surge : Ether climbed as much as 4.84% to near $1,900, Solana gained up to 5.48%, and XRP rose 3.53% amid broader positive sentiment before partial pullbacks. Trump speech impact : Crypto trimmed gains during the address defending economic policies, with no mention of digital assets despite his pro-crypto reputation since returning to the White House. Cautious market signals : Heavy put option buying near $58,000 for early March expiry reflects downside fears tied to geopolitical risks like potential US-Iran tensions. name: Ximena, United We Dream
subject: Ten years from now
body:
We, the people, power this country — we can build the better future we all want to see. | | | **We’re not reaching out about last night, Peter.** We need to talk about the future, and what it’s going to take to get there. When we envision what the next ten years could look like, we see our community strong and growing _because we planted the seeds of change today._ While that includes engaging our communities and advocating for policy change, it’s also taking care of ourselves so we can take care of others. It’s imagining something _better_ for our families, our communities, and the world. _It’s finding joy._ **United We Dream is rooted in uniting young people around what we can create together.** We have seen major moments of crisis, historic victories, and so much in between — but when the floor beneath us crumbles, our strength truly comes from leaning on each other. That looks like bringing your neighbors together to take meaningful action, whether that’s making a point to check in with one another or organizing a community event. It looks like coming together to build a future where everyone is free to live, speak, and be themselves, and where our communities have what they need to thrive, regardless of their background. **We, the people, are the builders and creators who power this country. We can build the better future we all want to see, too.** [**If our vision gives you hope, can you make a donation to United We Dream today? clean_body: We, the people, power this country — we can build the better future we all want to see. | | | We’re not reaching out about last night, Peter. We need to talk about the future, and what it’s going to take to get there. When we envision what the next ten years could look like, we see our community strong and growing because we planted the seeds of change today. While that includes engaging our communities and advocating for policy change, it’s also taking care of ourselves so we can take care of others. It’s imagining something better for our families, our communities, and the world. It’s finding joy. United We Dream is rooted in uniting young people around what we can create together. We have seen major moments of crisis, historic victories, and so much in between — but when the floor beneath us crumbles, our strength truly comes from leaning on each other. That looks like bringing your neighbors together to take meaningful action, whether that’s making a point to check in with one another or organizing a community event. It looks like coming together to build a future where everyone is free to live, speak, and be themselves, and where our communities have what they need to thrive, regardless of their background. We, the people, are the builders and creators who power this country. We can build the better future we all want to see, too. clean_body: I make the political class nervous. That’s why they are coming after me. | Fellow Patriot, I am going to be straight with you. Our Texas primary is less than one week from today. The establishment is pulling out all the stops to defeat me - because I have never been afraid to stand up to the Swamp in Washington. I've taken on both parties - and that hasn't made things easy. I've stood up to the swamp to ban stock trading by members of Congress - because public service should never be a get-rich scheme. I've fought to keep our elections free, fair, and secure - because confidence in our system in the foundation of our Republic. And I've worked to protect our communities and defend the rule of law and American values here at home. This kind of leadership makes the political class nervous. The lobbyists. Career Politicians. But I don't answer to them, Fellow Patriot. I answer to YOU and the American patriots across the country who deserve better from Washington. With less than 7 days before our Primary, I need every conservative who believes in limited government, secure elections, and real accountability to step up. I need you by my side. Peter,
Last week, COURIER was one of the only outlets to question missing Epstein files tied to Donald Trump:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126126758/603983780/90330534?refcode=20260225_Epstein_X&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzBjNzA5YjgtNzkxMi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=80O_PVpVxksYLjMoOOA_evc8ord0j70XgCcfVzDWmwo=)

**According to NPR, the withheld material includes FBI interviews with a woman who alleged that Donald Trump sexually abused her when she was a minor decades ago — interviews the FBI conducted multiple times.**
The allegations were serious enough for federal law enforcement to formally document and investigate. The FBI does not conduct repeated interviews over a “hoax.” It does so when allegations meet a threshold warranting inquiry.

Instead, we’re seeing hesitation — and fear of Donald Trump. Much of the corporate press is treating this like radioactive material.
Why? Because the incentives have changed.
**Billionaire owners prioritize profit and protection over confrontation. Media executives know lawsuits, regulatory threats, and access can all be weaponized. So the press hedges when it should push.**
That is how democracies rot:
When allegations serious enough for FBI investigation are treated as too uncomfortable to pursue. When a President becomes too dangerous to question.
That’s not neutrality. That’s dereliction of duty.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: They just launched an ad attacking me
body:
We’re going to beat them, but I need you with me
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=638%2E124072%2Ee387Yc)
Peter, Michael Whatley and our GOP opponents launched a new ad about me during the State of the Union last night, and guess what — **they’re lying about me again.** Never mind that they’ve been fact checked as false. They don’t care. This is just the latest example of the lengths they will go to win this race. **[I have more to say, but first, I have to ask you to donate to our campaign. We’re launching an emergency goal to raise $20,000 today so that we can fight back against these lies and make sure that North Carolinians see the real choice in this race. If you’re able, please chip in $20 today.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6299?amount=20&t=7&akid=638%2E124072%2Ee387Yc)** I’m used to my opponents lying about me. I’ve been around the block a few times, and this is nothing new. **What’s new is the amount of money that they can put behind these lies.** We knew that this could be the most expensive Senate race in history, and it’s certainly shaping up that way. Between Whatley, the far-right super PACs supporting him, and the Republican establishment (including Donald Trump), **they have nearly half a billion dollars to spend spreading lies about me and this campaign.** It’s a scary amount of money, but I need you to know that I’m not afraid. That’s because I’ve seen the power of campaigns powered by the people, by folks like you who chip in $20, $10, or even just $5 when they can. When we stick together, we can beat anything coming our way. **[But I need you to stick with me today. That money is surely burning a hole in our opponents’ pockets, and we have to be ready for when they decide to start spending it. So please, rush a contribution to our campaign today to help us hit our emergency $20,000 goal, if you can.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6300?t=8&akid=638%2E124072%2Ee387Yc)** Thank you for being with us, today and always. Roy Cooper [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6301?t=9&akid=638%2E124072%2Ee387Yc)
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

**TOP DOUGLAS COUNTY LEADERS RALLY BEHIND RETIRED REAR ADMIRAL EILEEN LAUBACHER** _Colorado HD-43 Rep. Bob Marshall and former Douglas County Democratic party chair Angela Thomas throw their support behind Eileen_
---
| | **Highlands Ranch, CO** – Today, retired Rear Admiral Eileen Laubacher announced endorsements from Bob Marshall and Angela Thomas. They are both leaders in Colorado’s 4th Congressional District and their endorsements signal ever growing support for Eileen Laubacher's campaign.

| | | | | | | | | | | | **Bob Marshall, the first Democrat elected to partisan office in Douglas County in more than 60 years had this to say,** _“If we are serious about winning Colorado’s 4th District, Eileen Laubacher is our strongest candidate. Peter,

**I'm not a career politician. I'm a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey and answered our nation's call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks.** I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war.

Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, **defunded our police** , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. **While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe.** This isn't the Minnesota I grew up in—or the one any Minnesotan deserves.

body:
Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-kqs1grv7ud-12932488?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| | | | |
---
| |
# NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN
---
| | Friends and Neighbors,
**We just finished up Week 6 of Session, and things are moving along quickly!** I continue working alongside my colleagues to advance legislation that puts Florida first, with a focus on protecting freedoms, supporting families, and strengthening Florida’s future. I look forward to sharing updates as the session continues.
As always, please do not hesitate to [**contact my office**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=0adbff645f&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.
---
| |
# PROPERTY TAX BILL PASSES the HOUSE FLOOR!
---
| | The Florida House of Representatives approved a joint resolution, [**HJR203**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=a67feddc1b&e=d1c1b9864f), on Thursday to put in motion a possible constitutional amendment on the November ballot that would completely end non-school property taxes for homesteaded properties beginning on January 1, 2027.
---
|
---
| | **Click here to watch my debate:** [**https://www.facebook.com/reel/3917061915258152**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=2ea5a46e28&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.facebook.com/reel/3917061915258152")
I was proud to stand and say what many Floridians already know. The increase in local government spending is out of control, and the solution is right in front of us. **Reduce and eventually eliminate property taxes, and let the tourists and new movers pay for it.**
My remarks here are in support of [**Rep. Monique Miller for State Representative District 33 legislation**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=11f7d6bfb3&e=d1c1b9864f) , which would eliminate property taxes on homesteads (except for the taxes levied by school districts). This is a powerful step in the right direction.
**My legislation would be a COMPLETE elimination of property taxes,** with an appropriate replacement through other revenue collection, and I truly believe this is where Florida is headed. We cannot continue to allow a system of taxation that takes your property if you can't pay the taxes.
Under that system, we are mere renters, and the government is the ultimate owner of our property. That is simply unacceptable and un-American, and it's certainly not how things should be done in the Free State of Florida.
Consider the data. Local government revenue has outpaced personal income by 2 to 1. That’s totally unacceptable. We must start cutting now and pursue full elimination of property taxes.
**This is the start of a new era for the State of Florida.**
---
| |
# Bills Presented:
---
| |
* [**HB 529**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=fb596e6685&e=d1c1b9864f) made it through its second committee and has been added to the Judiciary Committee agenda.
* **Why I Filed This Bill:** Community-Based Care (CBC) lead agencies and their contracted providers are experiencing a significant insurance coverage crisis. Since foster care and related services were outsourced, liability insurance costs have increased substantially, while the number of commercial insurers willing to underwrite these policies in Florida has declined sharply. As a result, very few carriers remain in this market.

* [**If you'd like to follow my bills, please click: Representative Ryan Chamberlin2026- Sponsored Bills | Florida House of Representatives**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=c8dd0ab8d5&e=d1c1b9864f "https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=ded723add5&e=a696a6dd1a")

---
| |
# Events/Receptions This Week:
---
| | This week, I attended several events in Tallahassee, including the **Florida Ocean’s Day Reception.** It was a great opportunity to spend time with colleagues and leaders while recognizing important work taking place across our state.
---
| |
# Meetings This Week:
---
|
---
| | I had the opportunity to meet with **AMIkids** to learn more about their work supporting young people through education, workforce development, and life skills programs that help them build confidence and succeed.
---
|
---
|
---
| | Great meeting with the **Center for Independent Living of North Central Florida** to discuss the important work they do to empower individuals with disabilities and promote independence throughout our community.
From providing essential services and advocacy to helping individuals live more self-sufficient lives, their impact across North Central Florida is truly inspiring. Thank you for stopping by and for your continued commitment to improving quality of life for so many in our region!
---
|
---
|
---
| | It was great to meet with **Hall of Famer Cris Carter, Former Florida State Head Coach Jimbo Fisher,** and the **Florida Coaches Coalition** to discuss the important role coaches play in mentoring our students and strengthening communities across our state.
From teaching teamwork and discipline to helping young people build confidence and character, coaches have a lasting impact both on and off the field. Thank you for your advocacy, your leadership, and for all you do each day to support Florida’s student-athletes!
---
|
---
|
---

Last night, Donald Trump stood before the country and declared, “our nation is back.” Back to what? _Back to families torn apart by ICE raids that terrorize entire communities?_ _Back to tax handouts for billionaires while working families struggle to pay rent and buy groceries?_ _Back to “drill baby drill,” slashing environmental protections and gutting the EPA so polluters can cash in?_ If that’s what he means by “back,” then we want no part of it. Because the future we’re fighting for looks very different. It’s a future where our children breathe clean air and drink clean water. Where democracy isn’t chipped away for political gain. Where freedom of speech and justice aren’t hollow slogans — they’re values we fiercely protect for everyone who calls this nation home. That future doesn’t happen on its own; we build it by organizing, showing up, and helping to elect leaders who are ready to fight for it. So that’s exactly what we’re doing. Right now, our team at JanePAC is identifying and supporting bold climate and democracy champions in must-win federal races, critical down-ballot seats, and even overlooked local offices like utility boards — the places where real decisions about our air, water, and energy future get made. We’ve already endorsed over 25 leaders this year, and more are on the way. Every one of them is an indispensable part of the firewall we’re building against Trump’s authoritarian agenda and his fossil fuel backers. **But here’s the truth: this work takes real resources. And we have to be ready because Trump is desperate to hold onto power, and he and his cronies have already raised millions to elect leaders who’ll do Big Oil’s bidding in Congress and in the states. That’s why we turn to you as often as we do.** In moments like this, it matters how we show up. **[So in the hours after Trump’s rambling, hate-fueled State of the Union, we’re asking you to help make the strength of this grassroots movement impossible to ignore. clean_body: | Last night, Donald Trump stood before the country and declared, “our nation is back.” Back to what? Back to families torn apart by ICE raids that terrorize entire communities? Back to tax handouts for billionaires while working families struggle to pay rent and buy groceries? Because the future we’re fighting for looks very different. It’s a future where our children breathe clean air and drink clean water. Where democracy isn’t chipped away for political gain. Where freedom of speech and justice aren’t hollow slogans — they’re values we fiercely protect for everyone who calls this nation home. That future doesn’t happen on its own; we build it by organizing, showing up, and helping to elect leaders who are ready to fight for it. So that’s exactly what we’re doing. Right now, our team at JanePAC is identifying and supporting bold climate and democracy champions in must-win federal races, critical down-ballot seats, and even overlooked local offices like utility boards — the places where real decisions about our air, water, and energy future get made. We’ve already endorsed over 25 leaders this year, and more are on the way. Every one of them is an indispensable part of the firewall we’re building against Trump’s authoritarian agenda and his fossil fuel backers. But here’s the truth: this work takes real resources. And we have to be ready because Trump is desperate to hold onto power, and he and his cronies have already raised millions to elect leaders who’ll do Big Oil’s bidding in Congress and in the states. body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126129570/603993266/1887110431?amount=15&source=EM_NBI_AB_20260224_FR_EOM_0_6MO_AmiBera_NA_NA_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMTYzMmZiMC03ZjEyLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sZysr_GIbxjiQo25yH2PxckRh89vqUUQIY4p9erRILE=) Peter,

We all want free and fair elections, but Trump and his allies in Congress have created a “solution” to a problem that _doesn’t_ exist.

The SAVE Act would make voter registration harder for millions of Americans. It bans military IDs, requires proof-of-citizenship documentation like passports, and disproportionately impacts married women and lower-income voters.

This isn’t about election integrity. **It’s about voter _suppression_.** And I won’t stand for it.

The latest release of the Epstein files – and what it’s hiding
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126129784/603993896/938567526?refcode=header&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTFkMzkxOC04MDEyLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o059ojWiAGy9al7aMO6ljqL4KXR2jpJpVca7PC2DQVw=)
Recently, the Department of Justice released millions of pages related to Jeffrey Epstein — and then claimed the job was done.

body:
I’m not going to stay silent while the most powerful man lies about my community. | Fight for Reform is dedicated to electing Democrats, transforming our broken campaign finance system, and ending _Citizens United_ state by state. If you would like to get fewer emails, [**_click here._**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/59469?t=1&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u) If you would like to unsubscribe, [**_click here._**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/59470?t=2&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u) [](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73153?t=3&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u) Team, I got into it with the President last night.

[**I’m not going to stay silent while the most powerful man lies about my community and spreads even more fear and hatred.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73153?t=4&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u)

The truth is simple: Donald Trump has killed innocent Americans. Two of them were my constituents. Their names are Alex Pretti and Renee Good.

But those names did not come out of the President's mouth last night. [**Because he is a coward.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73153?t=5&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u)

Trump should be ashamed of himself — him and the entire Republican Party have no empathy for their fellow Americans. They don’t care that ICE murdered two citizens in cold-blood; that’s just collateral damage to them as they pursue their violent agenda of brutal crackdowns, mass detention, and deportation.

[**If you’re with me in the fight to defeat these cowardly fascists and turn back the clock on their destructive agenda, please rush a contribution between my campaign and Fight For Reform to power our movement today >>**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73153?t=6&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u) | [RUSH A DONATION >>](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73153?t=7&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u)
---
Last night, I spoke up with fire in my heart. [**Because I’m angry as hell.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73153?t=8&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u)

ICE swooped into my community based on a lie; that the Somali-American community is collectively guilty for the actions of a small few. That the very existence of people who look like me and share my story are not acceptable in Trump’s America.

[**They used this lie to unleash absolute chaos.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73153?t=9&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u)

ICE agents all but suspended civil rights in their pursuit of deportations. Anyone with an accent or a different skin color was stopped in the street or in their cars and racially profiled. Homes were violently entered without proper warrants. Everyone from refugees to legal residents to US citizens were swept up in illegal detentions.

When protesters and observers mobilized to fight back, ICE responded with unprecedented brutality. Ramming into civilian cars. Beating protesters with steel batons. Throwing innocent people to the ground. Ripping people from their vehicles through shattered glass. Tear-gassing and pepper-spraying babies, children, pregnant women, and the elderly. Shooting two innocent people dead in the street, with more injured.

[**What ICE did in Minnesota lays bare the sheer cruelty, violence, authoritarianism, and incompetence of Trump’s administration.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73153?t=10&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u)

But now, it’s our time. Our time to raise our voices high, even when the President is speaking. Our time to fight back and defend basic American values of freedom and justice. Our time to defeat the MAGA far-right so we can pursue a truly progressive agenda that leaves no Americans behind.

[**Team — I need you with me if we’re going to win. Please, chip in whatever you can afford today, split between me and Fight For Reform, and supercharge our movement to defeat Trump and his MAGA army so we can restore sanity and progress to these United States. I am sick and tired of the lies, the violence, and the corruption. Let’s fight back and WIN.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/73153?t=11&akid=23962%2E4449941%2EueoM8u)

Dear Friend,
With just a few days left in February, we have a chance to send a powerful message: Alabama will not back down from authoritarianism. Right now, the Trump administration is testing how far it can push -- bypassing Congress, punishing everyday Americans with reckless tariffs, and treating the Constitution like an inconvenience.
We've already seen the Supreme Court strike down some of those illegal tariffs as a huge win for families and businesses. But the fight is far from over. Every donation we receive in these final hours of February fuels our grassroots campaign -- the one powered by the people. We're building a coalition of Democrats, independents, and even principled Republicans who believe in the rule of law. Bipartisan leaders have already endorsed us because they see what's at stake. name: Katie Britt (R-AL)
subject: See the road that led me here.
