body:
Washington won’t like this...
|
---
| | | | [](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
---
| | |
---
| | Patriot,
My name is Katie Britt, and if it’s alright with you, I’d like to share a little about who I am. **I’m not part of the D.C. cocktail circuit, and I never will be._That’s just not who I am._**

In 2022, I was elected to represent the great state of Alabama in the United States Senate. I became the first woman in Alabama’s history to hold this seat—but that’s not why I ran.

I ran because I’m a _**mom**_ , a _**wife**_ , and a _**conservative**_ who’s fed up with the direction this country is heading. I came to Washington to fight for our families, to protect our values, and to bring some Alabama backbone to a broken system.

I didn’t come here to make friends with the political elite. I came here to stand up for the people who don’t have a voice in the room—and I’m not backing down.
---
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
Before coming to the Senate, I served as the first female president and CEO of the Business Council of Alabama, and before that, I was Chief of Staff to Senator Richard Shelby. **I’ve never shied away from a challenge—and I’ve never forgotten who I’m fighting for.** In every role I’ve held, my mission has been the same: _deliver real results for Alabama families and the American people._
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
Before starting my career in public service, I earned my undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Alabama. That experience taught me how to lead, think on my feet, and fight for what I believe in—**and it laid the foundation for _everything_ I’ve done since.**
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
But long before that, I was just a small-town girl from Enterprise, Alabama. My dad ran the local hardware store. My mom taught dance to almost every kid in town. We didn’t grow up with wealth or political connections. **We came from hard work, grit, and doing things the right way._That’s how I was raised, and that’s exactly how I lead._**
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
My husband Wesley and our two amazing kids are my rock. In 2011, a tornado tore through our home and nearly took our lives. That moment changed everything, and reminded me what truly matters. __**Faith** , **family** , and **resilience**.__
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
I’ve lived a life full of hard work, determination, and breaking barriers. There have been challenges and triumphs alike, but I wouldn’t trade any of it.

My story is a testament to what America stands for—the American Dream. From a small town in Alabama, I rose to become my state’s U.S. Senator—a woman who’s breaking barriers and fighting for conservative values every day.

_**_I’m living proof of the limitless opportunity and freedom that define this country._**_

But, I didn’t get here by playing it safe or staying quiet, **and I’m not about to start now.**

The radical Left wants to _silence_ conservatives like me. They want to drown out our voices and push their agenda without opposition, but I’m standing firm.

I’m fighting tooth and nail to keep up and push back hard, for Alabama, for our values, and for every American who believes in freedom.

**The support I’ve received so far means everything, but this fight is far from over.** We need the resources to keep going strong and hold our ground.

**[So, after hearing a bit of my story, will you take a moment to chip in whatever you can afford to help me keep up this fight? The road ahead won’t be easy, but I’ve faced tough battles before. And it would mean the world to have you standing with me.](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)**
|
---
[CHIP IN TO FIGHT WITH KATIE BRITT >>](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
Thank you, and may God bless America.

Katie Britt (R-AL)
|
---
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
| | ****

---
|
---
|
---
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
I didn’t run for Senate to sit quietly on the sidelines. I’m a mom, a conservative, and a proud Alabamian—and I came to fight for the values that make America strong.

_**Faith. Family. Freedom.**_

The Left is doing everything they can to tear it all down. But I didn’t come to Washington to play games. I came to fight for the people who feel forgotten, overlooked, and ignored.

From securing the border to protecting our kids and defending our way of life—I’m in this for the long haul.

**This fight isn’t easy, but it’s worth it. And I’m not going anywhere.**

Will you stand with me?
|
---
[STAND WITH KATIE >>](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|

body:
#
We must remember in times such as this: **we are not the crazy ones**. We are not the outlandish ones.
They want us to think we are crazy — we are sane.
To demand affordable housing, a decent wage, the right to healthcare, that we pay to care for our people instead of the flattening of Palestinians and oppressed people abroad is not a radical act — _it is basic and core humanity_.
We will send a loud message to President Donald Trump: **his authoritarianism is no good here**.
We will send a message to ICE: that **secret police do not belong here**.
When I think about what is happening throughout our nation today, and what Donald Trump has done in his demolition of the White House — we must let him know:
That house doesn’t belong to him. It belongs to us. **It belongs to the people of this country**.
There has been a day before this presidency, and there will be a day after.

I’ll tell you what’s crazy.
What’s crazy is the horror that was hidden in the Epstein files and would still be hidden if Rep. Massie and I hadn’t forced their release.
What’s crazy is sleepwalking toward another disastrous war in the Middle East that could cost trillions of dollars and thousands of lives.
And what’s crazy is attacking the people who are trying to stop it.
Before I go further, I need to know right now:
Do you have my back?

body:
Colorado should drop its membership in the California Clean Car Cartel
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
ICYMI, President Trump delivered his State of the Union last night! [You can watch the replay here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) C. J. Garbo wrote a strong piece on the sharp partisan divide after Trump declared that the government’s first duty is to protect American citizens—not illegal immigrants. Republicans stood. Democrats did not—marking a moment that quickly became the defining flashpoint of the night. [Read the full commentary here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Critics warn Colorado’s Medicaid model creates [“perverse incentives”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) that fuel expansion and budget gaps. [Spending has doubled from $8 billion to nearly $16 billion in a decade](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) despite enrollment stabilizing, with 182 health bills adding $858 million annually, staffing up 72 percent, and Medicaid now consuming 37 percent of the state budget—raising sustainability concerns.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A commentary urges Colorado to [exit California’s emissions mandate framework](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and reclaim regulatory independence. A Colorado mom is calling for caution after her son was prescribed estrogen, urging [stronger parental oversight](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The U.S. Supreme Court will review [Boulder’s climate lawsuit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) against energy companies, cartel violence in Mexico left DIA with [just one arriving flight from Puerto Vallarta](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and newly released Epstein files [reference Colorado ties](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), though a named developer denies wrongdoing.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Mexico has handed nearly [100 suspected cartel figures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to the U.S. after President Trump’s terrorist designation, signaling a renewed crackdown. A commentary argues [Olympic nationality swaps](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) have turned medals into a marketplace, while another warns that [modern moral decline mirrors the “days of Noah,”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) where patience precedes judgment.
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, February 25, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado should drop its membership in the California Clean Car Cartel.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SEAN PAIGE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_President Trump’s recent repeal of the “endangerment finding”—a Barack Obama-era rule that handed the federal government absolute power to regulate almost anything that emits CO2 emissions, in response to the alleged climate crisis—marks a potential turning point for Colorado._
_Why? Because it gives Colorado an opportunity, an invitation, to decouple from California clean car mandates we’ve been operating under for years._
_Most Coloradans probably don’t know that their state’s “clean car” mandates are written by an unelected board of all-powerful ecocrats called the California Air Resources Board (CARB.) But why would most Coloradans know this, since it was never debated by the legislature or approved as a ballot measure?_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[From $8 Billion to $16 Billion: How Colorado’s Medicaid Budget Doubled in a Decade](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Medicaid spending doubled despite enrollment stabilizing:** Colorado’s Medicaid budget grew from roughly $8 billion to nearly $16 billion in a decade, even as enrollment returned close to pre-pandemic levels.
* **182 health bills added nearly $858M annually in state costs:** Lawmakers layered eligibility expansions, reimbursement increases, and benefit changes between 2019 and 2025, significantly reshaping the program’s long-term cost structure.
* **Staffing surged far beyond caseload growth:** While enrollment rose just 7.6 percent from FY2018–2024, full-time staffing increased 72 percent, raising sustainability questions as Medicaid now consumes about 37 percent of the state budget.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Colorado Mom Urges Caution for Parents After Son’s Hormone Treatment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [IW FEATURES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Mother says son was fast-tracked into hormone treatment:** After just three therapy visits, a psychologist diagnosed her teenage son with gender dysphoria and he was prescribed estrogen, decisions she now questions.
* **Diagnosis based on minimal indicators, she claims:** The mother said the primary reasons cited were that her son had female friends and once went on a date with a boy—criteria she later described as deeply flawed.
* **Call for parents to reclaim authority from “gender ideology”:** Now speaking out, she urges families to challenge medical recommendations and resist what she views as ideological influence within schools and health systems.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[As in the Days of Noah: Moral Decline, Divine Patience, and the Certainty of Judgment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY C. J. GARBO | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 24** _Civilizations do not collapse at random. They follow patterns. Scripture presents that pattern with clarity. Moral order produces stability. Moral rebellion produces decay. The sequence is consistent across centuries and continents._
**[The question no court has answered: Was Tina Peters jailed for speech?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | FEBRUARY 23** _Despite months and months of litigation in both state and federal courts, no appellate court has ruled on whether Tina Peters’ speech was constitutionally protected—or whether it was improperly used to justify keeping her behind bars._
**[Congress Should Fix Our Forests Before the Next Red Flag Warning](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY HUNTER RIVERA | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 23** _I still remember the orange sky over Loveland in October 2020: ash on windshields, headlights at noon, and a horizon rimmed with flame. The Cameron Peak Fire burned more than 200,000 acres across the Arapaho and Roosevelt National Forests and Rocky Mountain National Park, destroying hundreds of structures and forcing thousands to evacuate. The same month, the East Troublesome Fire exploded across Grand County, jumping the Continental Divide and claiming lives. Those weren’t abstract “Western wildfire” headlines. They were in Northern Colorado’s front yard._

Why? Because it gives Colorado an opportunity, an invitation, to decouple from California clean car mandates we’ve been operating under for years. Most Coloradans probably don’t know that their state’s “clean car” mandates are written by an unelected board of all-powerful ecocrats called the California Air Resources Board (CARB.) But why would most Coloradans know this, since it was never debated by the legislature or approved as a ballot measure? | BY SHAINA COLE, Medicaid spending doubled despite enrollment stabilizing: Colorado’s Medicaid budget grew from roughly $8 billion to nearly $16 billion in a decade, even as enrollment returned close to pre-pandemic levels. 182 health bills added nearly $858M annually in state costs: Lawmakers layered eligibility expansions, reimbursement increases, and benefit changes between 2019 and 2025, significantly reshaping the program’s long-term cost structure. Staffing surged far beyond caseload growth: While enrollment rose just 7.6 percent from FY2018–2024, full-time staffing increased 72 percent, raising sustainability questions as Medicaid now consumes about 37 percent of the state budget. | The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. Hello — This is Priya Sundareshan, Senate Minority Leader of the Arizona State Legislature. In light of President Donald Trump’s unprecedented call to “nationalize” elections, I had to reach out. **There’s so much chaos going on in Washington that a comment like this can easily fly under the radar. But this is a real cause for concern.** First, it’s vital that we understand what this illegal power grab would entail. When Trump calls for nationalizing elections, this means that the federal government will interfere in our local races. It’s a threat against ALL voters and directly defies state’s rights and the U.S. Constitution. By shrouding voter suppression laws like the SAVE America Act and the MEGA Act under false claims of fraud and rigged elections, the Trump administration is effectively targeting voting rights ahead of major local and midterm elections. One of these bills already passed the U.S. House and is heading to the U.S. Senate. The crowd’s reaction said everything | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126133769/604006297/-785282667?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTE5YzNhMC04ODEyLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lTMBXh8F5L0plefZwccm01EyXVj-kCYhkuvzWiyE4n8=)

Peter, **I wanted to reach out today after what we all witnessed last night.** While Donald Trump stood before Congress delivering another speech filled with division, fear, and political theater, Becca was outside on the National Mall — standing shoulder to shoulder with organizers, advocates, and people directly impacted by this administration’s policies. And if you saw her remarks, you know why so many people are fired up today. She stepped up to the microphone and said: **“I like to refer to myself as that scrappy little dyke from Vermont, but tonight, I’m America’s scrappy little dyke.”** The crowd erupted. That’s who Becca is. Authentic. Fearless. Unapologetic about who she is and who she fights for. She also said something that stuck with all of us: **“I am a bare-knuckle brawler with a heart.”** A fighter when our rights are on the line — but grounded in compassion for the people she serves. And the contrast last night could not have been clearer. [_**Proud of Becca? Ready to fight back? Want to hold this lawless administration accountable? Click here and chip in ANY AMOUNT to help us win back the House and take our country back for the people.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126133770/604006298/1802995196?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTE5YzNhMC04ODEyLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lTMBXh8F5L0plefZwccm01EyXVj-kCYhkuvzWiyE4n8=) Inside that chamber: more blame, more division, more attempts to pit Americans against each other. Outside on the Mall: community, courage, and people determined to protect one another and move this country forward. **Becca reminded the crowd, “We are the ones we’ve been waiting for.” And she’s right. But if we’re going to turn that belief into real change, we have work to do.** If we are going to defend our rights...
If we are going to hold this administration accountable...
If we are going to get this country back on track for working people... **We have to win back the House.** **[HELP US TAKE BACK THE HOUSE!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126133771/604006299/1802995196?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTE5YzNhMC04ODEyLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lTMBXh8F5L0plefZwccm01EyXVj-kCYhkuvzWiyE4n8=)** That is how we put a real check on this administration. That is how we take our country back for the people — not the powerful. And that is how we get America moving in the right direction again. So we’re asking you today: If you were proud watching Becca last night...
If you believe we need more bare-knuckle brawlers with a heart in Congress...
If you’re ready to fight to win back the House... [_**Will you click here and chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can today?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126133772/604006300/1802995196?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTE5YzNhMC04ODEyLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lTMBXh8F5L0plefZwccm01EyXVj-kCYhkuvzWiyE4n8=) Every dollar helps us organize, mobilize, and build the kind of people-powered movement that can defeat the politics of fear. Last night was a reminder of something powerful. This country belongs to people who show up for each other — not the loudest voices of division. And Becca is going to keep fighting every single day, both inside Congress and out in the communities she serves. **Let’s win back the House. Let’s defend our rights. clean_body: The crowd’s reaction said everything | = Peter, I wanted to reach out today after what we all witnessed last night. While Donald Trump stood before Congress delivering another speech filled with division, fear, and political theater, Becca was outside on the National Mall — standing shoulder to shoulder with organizers, advocates, and people directly impacted by this administration’s policies. And if you saw her remarks, you know why so many people are fired up today. She stepped up to the microphone and said: “I like to refer to myself as that scrappy little dyke from Vermont, but tonight, I’m America’s scrappy little dyke.” The crowd erupted. That’s who Becca is. Authentic. Fearless. Unapologetic about who she is and who she fights for. She also said something that stuck with all of us: “I am a bare-knuckle brawler with a heart.” A fighter when our rights are on the line — but grounded in compassion for the people she serves. And the contrast last night could not have been clearer. = Inside that chamber: more blame, more division, more attempts to pit Americans against each other. Outside on the Mall: community, courage, and people determined to protect one another and move this country forward. Becca reminded the crowd, “We are the ones we’ve been waiting for.” And she’s right. But if we’re going to turn that belief into real change, we have work to do. If we are going to defend our rights... If we are going to hold this administration accountable... If we are going to get this country back on track for working people... We have to win back the House. = That is how we put a real check on this administration. That is how we take our country back for the people — not the powerful. And that is how we get America moving in the right direction again. So we’re asking you today: If you were proud watching Becca last night... If you believe we need more bare-knuckle brawlers with a heart in Congress... If you’re ready to fight to win back the House... = Every dollar helps us organize, mobilize, and build the kind of people-powered movement that can defeat the politics of fear. Last night was a reminder of something powerful. This country belongs to people who show up for each other — not the loudest voices of division. And Becca is going to keep fighting every single day, both inside Congress and out in the communities she serves. Let’s win back the House. Let’s defend our rights. | | Friends,

This week, Christian conservative businessman Brad Raffensperger unveiled a bold, commonsense plan to eliminate Georgia’s state income tax on all retirement benefits.

_“For decades, Georgia retirees have been punished for doing the right thing,” Raffensperger said. “They worked hard, saved responsibly, paid their taxes, and then the government comes back for a second bite when they are on fixed income. That ends when I’m Governor.”_

**Here’s what Brad’s plan does:**
✔ Eliminates Georgia’s state income tax on 401(k) benefits
✔ Eliminates taxes on traditional IRA distributions
✔ Eliminates taxes on pensions and annuities
✔ Eliminates taxes on Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
✔ Completes the job of making Georgia an income tax free state for retirees
**What This Means for Retirees**
At Georgia’s current income tax rate, a retiree withdrawing $100,000 annually would save roughly $5,000 per year.

Over 20 years of retirement, that’s more than $100,000 back in their pocket.
With stubborn inflation, rising healthcare costs, and increasing property taxes, Georgia seniors are facing an affordability crisis. Brad’s plan helps them keep more of what they earned so they can thrive, not just get by.
**In The News**
This week, Brad’s proposal was covered in the Atlanta Journal-Constitution:
[AJC Politically Georgia - Brad's Retirement Tax Relief Plan](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=8a4650d11f&e=6036811227)
This plan is part of Brad’s broader vision to make Georgia affordable and safe. While others talk, Brad is rolling out a serious policy agenda for our state’s future.
Brad Raffensperger will Stand for Georgia — No Matter What.
— Team Raff

That ends when I’m Governor.” Here’s what Brad’s plan does: ✔ Eliminates Georgia’s state income tax on 401(k) benefits ✔ Eliminates taxes on traditional IRA distributions ✔ Eliminates taxes on pensions and annuities ✔ Eliminates taxes on Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs) ✔ Completes the job of making Georgia an income tax free state for retirees What This Means for Retirees At Georgia’s current income tax rate, a retiree withdrawing $100,000 annually would save roughly $5,000 per year. Over 20 years of retirement, that’s more than $100,000 back in their pocket. With stubborn inflation, rising healthcare costs, and increasing property taxes, Georgia seniors are facing an affordability crisis. Brad’s plan helps them keep more of what they earned so they can thrive, not just get by. In The News This week, Brad’s proposal was covered in the Atlanta Journal-Constitution: This plan is part of Brad’s broader vision to make Georgia affordable and safe. While others talk, Brad is rolling out a serious policy agenda for our state’s future. Peter, If you caught President Trump’s tirade at the State of the Union last night — and we don’t blame you a bit if you skipped it — you got an earful about the so-called SAVE America Act. Here’s what you need to know →
* **He mostly lied about what the bill would do.** If passed through the Senate, this law would suppress millions of votes, particularly among married women, younger voters, people of color, and LGBTQ+ communities, by making it harder to register. Trump went even further, calling for requiring proof of citizenship to register (such as a passport or birth certificate) and ending regular voting by mail.

We know Trump gets things wrong all the time, so why does this matter so much? _It’s because he said the quiet part out loud, folks._ They explicitly want it to be a lot harder to vote in America.
* **He wants to prioritize the SAVE Act above all else.** In case it wasn’t clear how desperate they are, they don’t want Congress to do anything until the GOP has taken a sledgehammer to our right to vote. Trump demanded Congress must pass this voter-suppressing bill “before anything else happens.”
* **He said that “the only way” Democrats can win elections is by cheating.** That’s right, the guy whose poll numbers are so atrocious that he’s trying to change electoral maps and voting rules at the last minute to gain any possible advantage in the midterm elections is accusing our side of cheating. He’s telling on himself.

**The bottom line is we’re not going to take this threat lying down. Peter, it’s Abigail Spanberger, Governor of Virginia. I just finished delivering the Democratic response to Donald Trump’s State of the Union address, and I wanted to reach out to you directly.

Americans expect and deserve leaders who are working hard to deliver for them.**That is not what we saw last night. The state of the union under Donald Trump is failing American families.**

But know this, Peter: Democrats are focusing relentlessly on what matters most. We’re bringing people together – not stoking division. We’re lowering costs and delivering real relief for families, farmers, and business owners – not unleashing trade wars and hiking taxes. We’re keeping our communities safe – not escalating violence and fear in our cities.

**But this work doesn’t happen in a vacuum. When Trump gutted health care and caused premiums to skyrocket, I fought tooth and nail to extend the Affordable Care Act tax credits and lower costs.
When the Supreme Court just ruled Trump’s tariffs illegal, I called on the Trump administration to repay every Colorado small business that has been crushed by these tariff-taxes.

name: Katie Porter
subject: Say it with me: Fuck Trump
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=40898%2E3422442%2EDEViKs)
_**Katie Porter spoke at the California Democratic Party Convention on Saturday. Please take a moment to read her remarks below and[then donate to her campaign for governor.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260225_1_ak.z3-bkB&refcode=em20260225-40898&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=40898%2E3422442%2EDEViKs)**_
I’m Katie Porter. Some of you know me as the whiteboard lady who held CEOs and billionaires accountable in Congress.
So today, I wanna start with one simple, powerful message we all agree on.
Say it with me. Ready, 1 ... 2 ... 3...
_**Fuck Trump.**_
Yeah, that’s right, Fuck Trump. Together, we’re going to kick Trump’s ass in November and stop him in his tracks.
I’ll stand up to Trump and his cronies again and again, just as I did in Congress—with or without my whiteboard. But this election for Governor is about far more than defeating Trump.
We _**KNOW**_ what Trump is willing to do and how far he’s willing to go—he’s willing to kill people in the streets, to rip health care away, to ruthlessly attack our democracy.
But this governor’s race asks US—what are WE willing to do? What is CALIFORNIA willing to do for our democracy?
Who we elect as our next Governor is the biggest, most powerful statement we can make in 2026 about who Democrats are, in California, and nationally. About what we stand for, and about what we will do.
Let’s elect a bold leader who WILL DO big things—the things we have long fought for. When I’m your governor, I will deliver:
* Single payer health care,
* Less expensive housing,
* Free child care for all,
* Zero tuition charges at our UCs and CSUs,
* And, thousands of dollars back in families pockets, by eliminating California income tax for those earning less than $100,000.

Those are real affordability solutions!
For decades, we have fought for these ideas. We’ve organized. We’ve voted. We’ve pushed this party to be better.
I am running for Governor because I am WILLING and READY to get those things done!
But you know who is standing in our way? Billionaires and huge corporations that have far too much power in our country—and too much influence in Sacramento. I’ll take them DOWN and LIFT UP the working people of this state.
Look, I understand, there’s a lot that makes me unique in this race—and some of that scares people. I’m the single mom of three kids, I push a grocery cart, fill my minivan with gas, and pay the bills. I understand what it’s like to watch expenses like utilities and insurance go up and dollars not stretch far enough, because I’ve experienced that too.
We’ve never had a governor like that in California. Heck, we’ve never had a governor in heels! And I think it’s about damn time.
My differences will make me a better Governor, better able to address the challenges Californians face.
California Democrats, our country is counting on us to lead the way—to send a message about our democracy—by rejecting billionaires and corporate-backed candidates—and picking as governor, the ONLY candidate who has NEVER taken a dime of corporate PAC money.
In this election, there is a very real possibility that Republicans could sneak two candidates into the runoff. We CANNOT let that happen.
But let’s aim higher than stopping them. Let’s seize the opportunity to elect someone who is WILLING to get big things done and READY to live up to our progressive ideals.
My campaign IS our Democratic values, powered by small donations from 70,000 people just like you. And how you campaign is how you serve. I humbly ask for your support, not to be Governor “Of” California, but to Govern FOR ALL Californians.
Thank you.
_And Fuck Trump._
Katie Porter is running for governor to stand up to Trump and lower costs for working families. We need your help to win.
**[Please donate $5 today.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260225_1_ak.z3-bkB&refcode=em20260225-40898&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=40898%2E3422442%2EDEViKs)**

Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4g-em-footer?refcode=em20260225-40898&amounts=&t=5&refcode2=40898_3422442_DEViKs&akid=40898%2E3422442%2EDEViKs)**

Kash Patel claims he loves America, and that's why he celebrated with the U.S. Men's Hockey team.

| |

Friend, Fox News is attacking me for telling the truth. They want this to be about sports. It isn’t. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126135911/604013027/610046935?q=https://www.foxnews.com/video/6389757879112&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1772035873764392&usg=AOvVaw0j-8Dv5rE7o4Yrr5x3yjlv&refcode=260225_sm_kp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYTJlN2YxMC04ZTEyLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GS7ux0yy_pWzQrKb13zWsYZKbpcNrj2L1c6vfX7jOxo=&emci=58f0beac-6d12-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=2a2e7f10-8e12-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=194769) Kash Patel says he loves America. That’s the image he wants you to see, but loving this country isn’t about chugging beer at the Olympics. I have served this country in uniform and in Congress, and I know that loving America is actually about:
* Upholding the Constitution
* Letting the law guide your decisions, not Donald Trump’s political interests
* Protecting the people who are trying to uphold the law, not firing them when it’s politically inconvenient for Trump
* Speaking out when Trump pardons hundreds of insurrectionists who tried to overthrow our government on January 6th

Kash Patel doesn’t love America. He loves Trump. And he’s using his position to jet around the world and party at the expense of our democracy, and on our democracy’s dime. That’s what was really going on in that locker room. Not patriotism, a political performance.

I refuse to sit idly by while they attack our country's values and institutions under the veil of fake patriotism, and I'm running for Senate to fight back.

I’ve been clear about this everywhere I go, and I’m willing to go anywhere, including Fox News, to confront lies about our democracy. If we’re going to change people’s minds, we can’t avoid the places where the lies are being spread.

name: Chaz Molder
subject: This is about costs and accountability

body:
Rising prices. Clear choices.

| | | | |
---
Hi Peter, Families across Middle Tennessee are paying more for everyday goods. Groceries cost more. Gas costs more. Stretching a paycheck is harder than it should be. And in Washington, Rep. Andy Ogles is making it worse. Instead of fighting to lower costs, Rep. Ogles has voted repeatedly to protect policies that drive prices up, including sweeping tariffs that raise costs for working families and small businesses right here at home. Most recently, he voted to block oversight and let those policies keep hurting Tennesseans. He promised to lower costs. His votes tell a different story. I’m running for Congress because Middle Tennessee deserves a representative who takes rising costs seriously and who actually works to bring them down, rather than someone who rubber-stamps decisions that make life harder for the people back home. This race is competitive — and in fact, it was just named to the DCCC's very selective Red to Blue program. We earned our way here by doing the work across Middle Tennessee. As we approach the end of the month, we need to show that this campaign has the strength and support to keep reaching voters, holding Ogles accountable, and making the case for lower costs across the district. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Donald Trump stood in the U.S. Capitol last night and gaslit the American people (and Members of Congress) for 108 minutes straight.
I didn’t go to the State of the Union, but I can tell you this for sure:
Trump didn’t acknowledge that the problem of affordability in our country is a real crisis (not a Democratic hoax!), let alone put forth any solutions or ideas to address it.
So what did he do?
Well, he lied.
Then he lied again.
And then he lied some more! About everything from his illegal tariffs to the devastating impacts of his so-called big, beautiful bill, to the realities of his administration’s brutal and inhumane immigration tactics.
Here’s the truth:
Trump’s reckless economic policies are driving costs higher, making everyday life less affordable for people all across the country, and grinding wage growth to a standstill.
His policies have exploded the deficit, trashed America’s place on the global stage, and transferred massive amounts of money from working people’s pockets straight into the hands of the ultra-rich.
His administration has brought chaos to our streets and sown division, fear, and violence in our communities.
His DOJ has orchestrated a massive cover-up of the dark and depraved crimes committed by Jeffrey Epstein and protected Epstein’s co-conspirators and enablers at every turn.
And his refusal to take accountability for ANY OF THIS is breathtakingly insulting to the American public.
I could write a novel to you about the disasters of this administration, but here’s what’s really on my mind today:
It’s not enough just to be anti-Trump, and it’s not enough to just focus on taking the GOP down in the midterms and in 2028.
It is vitally important for Democrats to have a clear, affirmative, forward-looking plan for delivering results and making people’s lives better when we’re in power.
That’s one reason why my team is always focused on writing and introducing new legislation and championing important bills in the House — because the moment we flip the House, we'd better be ready to get sh!t done.
It’s also why I’m proud to be part of House Democratic leadership, building our proactive agenda, defining our priorities, and setting our legislative and outreach strategies.
And it’s why I’m so grateful for this team — your feedback, your energy, and your partnership are all critical to fighting back today AND building a stronger future.
Right now, I’m asking for your help. My campaign team is pushing towards a February fundraising goal to support our efforts to flip the House, and we have $2,805 left to raise by Saturday night.
Will you click here to contribute towards our February goal? No amount is too small — it all adds up, and it all makes a difference in what we can build between now and November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]

Thank you very much for giving when you can. If you’re not in a position to donate right now, I want you to know that I get it, and I really appreciate you reading these emails and staying in touch regardless!
This team is so much more than donations or petitions or emails — our collective dedication to protecting democracy and creating a better tomorrow is how we fight back, and it’s how we WIN.
Warmly,
Sara

| | **This Moment Matters - Familiarity, Minnesota Roots, and the Moment Before Us**

---
| |

Friends,
There’s an old saying: familiarity breeds contempt.
In small-town rural Minnesota, I’ve seen how that plays out. When you grow up with someone—when they’re the neighbor kid, the familiar face at the local store, or “the girl down the road”—it’s easy to take their strengths for granted. We get so used to the steady, reliable people around us that we sometimes forget to pause and appreciate just how valuable those qualities really are.
I was raised with the small-town values we all recognize: loyalty to family, respect for neighbors, keeping your word, and showing up when it matters. Those principles have guided my life. I’ve built lifelong friendships here, and I’m always open to making new ones. I strive to stay approachable, down-to-earth, and genuine. I listen more than I talk, and I believe trust is earned through actions, not announcements.
What I’ve learned is that the most dependable leaders often come from exactly these roots. They don’t need flash or ego to get things done—they bring consistency, integrity, and a genuine heart for the people they serve.
Minnesota has an incredible opportunity in 2026. With the U.S. Senate seat open, we can choose representation that feels like us: steady, fair, honest, and deeply connected to the real lives of families across our state—whether in Glencoe, Maple Grove, the Iron Range, or the Twin Cities.
Both parties talk about serving everyday people, but right now [**we have a President in who is making it real**](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=cca2aa83fc&e=49d94faf06)**.** We have the opportunity to flip this seat, to elevate leaders who reflect our values, who understand our challenges, and who will fight for all Minnesotans without self-interest getting in the way.
This campaign is about more than any one person—it’s about recognizing and choosing the kind of leadership our state deserves. Leadership grounded in character, not headlines. So take a fresh look at what really matters. Look at the values. Look at the commitment to this state and its people.
**Let’s seize this moment to bring strong, principled representation to Washington -- to support President Donald J. TRUMP in his endeavor to Make America Great.** Help flip Minnesota red and deliver the change we need.
If this resonates with you, please let me know—[**share this email with friends**](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=1c020ed85c&e=49d94faf06), [make a donation if you’re able, or drop me a message, text, or social media note.](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=4caefcf015&e=49d94faf06) Tell me how you’d like to get involved. Together, we can flip this state to common sense leadership.
With gratitude and determination,
Alycia R. Gruenhagen **Candidate for U.S. Senate, Minnesota** Glencoe, MN **www.alycia4senate.com** Proudly representing OUR SHARED Minnesota values.

At a time when Donald Trump and his allies are escalating harm, attacking our democracy, hurting our people, and emboldening white supremacy, I refuse to pretend that sitting quietly is some kind of resistance.
Silence is not defiance. Silence is complicity.

You wouldn't catch me normalizing this man or the harm he causes. This moment demands action. It demands that we show up loudly for the people being hurt right now.
I didn’t run for Congress to be polite. I didn’t run to follow the rules of a broken system.
I ran to fight and to stand with the people, even when it makes the Washington status quo uncomfortable.
In a little under six months, I’m facing a primary opponent backed by corporate PACs and special interests who benefit from silence, because silence protects their power. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q1?refcode=x_260225_sotu_act]

name: Sen. Jeff Bridges
subject: Endorsed by every union that's endorsed
body:
All the labor unions that have endorsed in the State Treasurer’s race have endorsed our campaign.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b6844bfc9561/get-more-smarter-on-colorados-budget-10373728?e=b48bb2b4f4)
---
[|
---](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=afb460191b&e=b48bb2b4f4)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi there,
Teachers. Plumbers. Pipefitters. State employees. Healthcare workers. When working people across Colorado all agree, it means something.
**I’m honored that every labor union that’s endorsed in the State Treasurer’s race has endorsed our campaign.**
---
[|
---](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=09ccbaf3ce&e=b48bb2b4f4)
| | These endorsements matter to me. Not just politically, but personally.
My father-in-law Mike was a proud CWA member for 40 years. He didn’t always agree with his union leaders, but he never doubted what the union made possible. Mike didn’t go to college, but he built advanced technical skills, earned a good living, and used that stability to send his book-loving daughter to some of the best universities in the country. That’s a story of the American dream more people should have access to.
And unions made that dream possible.
---
[|
---](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=1527cf372b&e=b48bb2b4f4)
| | I’ve always believed that when businesses do well, their employees should do well too. Unions fight to make sure that we lift as we rise. When workers have a real stake, you see higher wages, stronger businesses, and wealth that stays rooted in local communities.
**As Treasurer, I’ll invest Colorado dollars here in Colorado in ways that create good-paying union jobs and long-term opportunity. Housing that working families can afford. Infrastructure that builds our economy. Clean energy that lowers bills and creates careers you can raise a family on.**
I would be incredibly grateful to have your support at the State Assembly in Pueblo on March 28. If we haven’t talked already, reply here or reach out on my personal cell at 303-358-5551. I look forward to hearing from you!
---
| | Talk soon,
P.S. My aunt was a proud member of CEA, and my wife worked to unionize her fellow graduate student workers at Harvard—with the United Auto Workers!
---

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126137665/604018880/1826391520?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2JlMjk5N2UtOTQxMi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_EquqqygYhn7UhWIcSN9LII8FN1Iq8yic3COpX9t9v8=&emci=1633196d-8f12-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=3be2997e-9412-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=8470899)

| Hi Peter,

Last night, I delivered the Democratic response to the State of the Union from The House of Burgesses in Colonial Williamsburg.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126137666/604018881/-803653937?v=jICy6cXhhJk&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2JlMjk5N2UtOTQxMi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_EquqqygYhn7UhWIcSN9LII8FN1Iq8yic3COpX9t9v8=&emci=1633196d-8f12-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=3be2997e-9412-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=8470899)
| [WATCH THE RESPONSE ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126137667/604018882/-803653937?v=jICy6cXhhJk&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2JlMjk5N2UtOTQxMi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_EquqqygYhn7UhWIcSN9LII8FN1Iq8yic3COpX9t9v8=&emci=1633196d-8f12-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=3be2997e-9412-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=8470899)
---
In my response, I asked the American people three questions:

Is the President working to make life more affordable for you and your family?

Is the President working to keep Americans safe both at home and abroad?

Is the President working for you?

_We all know the answer to all three of these questions is no._

In his speech, the President did what he always does. He lied, he scapegoated, and he distracted – and he offered no real solutions to our nation's pressing challenges, so many of which he is actively making worse.

Since this President took office last year, his reckless trade policies have forced American families to pay more than $1,700 each in tariff costs. Small businesses have suffered, farmers have suffered, and everyday Americans are paying the price.

Here in Virginia, I’m working with our state legislature to lower costs and make the Commonwealth more affordable. And it's not just me – Democrats across the country are laser-focused on affordability, because in the most innovative and exceptional nation in the history of the world, Americans deserve to know that their leaders are focused on addressing the problems that keep them up at night.

But here's the special thing about America. **On our 250th anniversary, we know better than any nation what is possible when ordinary citizens reject the unacceptable and demand more of their government.**

In November, I won my election by 15 points and we won 13 new seats in our state legislature because voters decided they wanted something different. Our campaign earned votes from Democrats, Republicans, Independents, and everyone in between because they knew, as citizens, they could demand more.

In his farewell address, George Washington warned us about the possibility of “cunning, ambitious, and unprincipled men” rising to power. But he also encouraged us, all Americans, to unite in a common cause to move this nation forward. _That is our charge once more._

**We, the people, have the power to make change, the power to stand up for what is right, the power to demand more of our nation.**

How will you use that power?

Unfortunately, what I heard during the President’s speech was a whole lot of nothing:

No answers about handling the affordability crisis.
No answers about ripping healthcare away from millions.
No answers about stopping the illegal action by ICE.

subject: Why MAGA wants to end the VRA
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Knocking out this leg of the Voting Rights Act -- by weakening Section 2 -- would almost certainly reconstitute state legislatures, city councils, judicial districts, and every other type of political boundary in which racial minorities could be cut off from having a voice in their government.
This kind of change would silence untold numbers of voters and spiral our fight for voting rights back sixty years. RUSH $35 or more right now to help protect what the VRA stands for and defend our fundamental right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022526_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Mother Jones: Republican Justices Appear Poised to Destroy What’s Left of the Voting Rights Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022526_2&amount=25]
We'll hand this straight to Mother Jones, Team: " The Supreme Court, with its six-to-three Republican-appointed majority, appears ready to kneecap what remains of the Voting Rights Act’s protections for minority political representation. "
The descriptive language seems harsh, but the objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding.
During this week’s oral argument in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.
Team: We have to spread the word about this case and the consequences of dismantling the Voting Rights Act. Fuel our work with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend the right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022526_2&amount=35]

At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down districting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
“ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’”
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $35 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022526_2&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

body:
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
| **_FROM THE DESK OF RUDY W. GIULIANI_**
---
Peter,
---
This report gives me hope that justice will be served:
---
**_“Republicans are demanding _FULL_ _RESTITUTION_ for Rudy Giuliani, who was charged with 13 felony counts and fined $148 million after contesting Georgia’s 2020 election, following Fulton County’s admission that 315,000 votes were fraudulently counted.”_**
---
Since you’ve been supporting me through thick and thin, you know more than anyone that I’ve been dragged through _hell and back_ over the last 5 years.
---
**_And what was my terrible “crime?”_**
---
...As it turns out, my “crime” was speaking the __truth__ – God’s honest truth.
---
_Ballots were, in fact, WRONGLY counted. 315,000 of them to be exact – in a state decided by less than 12,000 votes!_
---
_If America becomes a country where Deep State goons and corrupt lawyers and judges can RUIN you for simply asking questions and telling the truth, then our Free Republic is _dead_._
---
**That’s why I’m not giving up the fight._And neither is President Trump_.**
---
Giving up this fight means giving up on what America stands for. It means surrendering to fear tactics and legal warfare.
---
**The bad guys who perverted our justice system cannot just get off with a slap on the wrist. Dropped charges and a dismissed prosecutor do not undo the catastrophic damage that was done.**
---
**That’s why I’m _humbly_ asking you to join Republicans who are calling for “FULL RESTITUTION” for yours truly.**
---
When these leftist crooks first had me booked in Georgia, they filed my mugshot under **booking # 2313757** ...
---
So my goal is to have **2,313,757** red-blooded Americans sign the petition for “full restitution.”

# Free Subscription to Climate Hope Together
Is there hope that something can be done about climate change, especially given the moment we are in? **I believe there is still hope because I believe in us**. This is my invitation to you for us to find hope together through a **free** subscription to my [_Climate Hope Together_ Substack](https://vvjoamr.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MTgzMTYsXCJsXCI6MTgwNDE1NTg2MTA4NDQyMzMzLFwiclwiOjE4MDQxNTU5OTIzMjQxOTY2N30iLCJzIjoiM2ZmZGRiZDUwNThkNGJkNiJ9). When you accept this invitation and subscribe for free to _Climate Hope Together_ you will find hope for our journey. What Climate Hope Together offers is **realistic hope** , grounded both in the challenge, and in our potential _together_ to overcome the this challenge. It’s right there in the name: we will find hope when we join together. On the Climate Hope Together Substack you will find a variety of Series to explore.
* The [Intro Series](https://vvjoamr.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MTgzMTYsXCJsXCI6MTgwNDE1NTg2MTE4OTI4MDk0LFwiclwiOjE4MDQxNTU5OTIzMjQxOTY2N30iLCJzIjoiMjExMTMzMmExNTJmZTdhOSJ9) provides an overview and introduction.
* [Olympian Fields of Action](https://vvjoamr.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MTgzMTYsXCJsXCI6MTgwNDE1NTg2MTI4MzY1MjgwLFwiclwiOjE4MDQxNTU5OTIzMjQxOTY2N30iLCJzIjoiOWQ0MmQwNjAzZjZmYTRlMSJ9) traverses the ways the Climate Movement can engage, utilizing the Olympics as the major metaphor.
* [Hope & Justice](https://vvjoamr.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MTgzMTYsXCJsXCI6MTgwNDE1NTg2MTM3ODAyNDY1LFwiclwiOjE4MDQxNTU5OTIzMjQxOTY2N30iLCJzIjoiNmRmYzM2MmI2MmNjNTA0NSJ9) explores the deep connection between them.
* [Our Story Together](https://vvjoamr.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MTgzMTYsXCJsXCI6MTgwNDE1NTg2MTQ2MTkxMDc0LFwiclwiOjE4MDQxNTU5OTIzMjQxOTY2N30iLCJzIjoiZTdlZjE3MGE5NjIwMmU1MCJ9) narrates our past, spotlights Climate Action Heroes, and paints a picture of what we can be together.
* _[The Catalytic-4](https://vvjoamr.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MTgzMTYsXCJsXCI6MTgwNDE1NTg2MTU0NTc5Njg0LFwiclwiOjE4MDQxNTU5OTIzMjQxOTY2N30iLCJzIjoiZmNkYzY0YjU3YTU1YTc4MCJ9)_ discusses the Four Catalytic Sources of Transformation through which we will prevail.
* [First Takes](https://vvjoamr.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MTgzMTYsXCJsXCI6MTgwNDE1NTg2MTYyOTY4MjkzLFwiclwiOjE4MDQxNTU5OTIzMjQxOTY2N30iLCJzIjoiMGUyNGY0NWQ0MTQxOGIwYyJ9) offers hot takes on what’s happening with the climate challenge.
* [Our Values](https://vvjoamr.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE5MTgzMTYsXCJsXCI6MTgwNDE1NTg2MTcwMzA4MzI2LFwiclwiOjE4MDQxNTU5OTIzMjQxOTY2N30iLCJzIjoiYjE2MzUwNjdlODhmODI3MSJ9) explores our Ten Movement Values: love, justice, beauty, creativity, freedom, wisdom, pragmatism, non-violence, sustainability, and success.

Together we are hope-makers, justice-achievers, and beauty-creators. We are the hope we’ve been waiting for.
**Claim your free subscription today** to the _Climate Hope Together_ Substack and stay plugged in to hope! **_Here’s how:_** When you click on one of the green Subscribe buttons in this email you will be taken to a page where you will input your email address and click the “Subscribe” tab. You will then be taken to the payment plan landing page with four options, as seen in the picture at the top of this email. Simply choose the option on the far right. I look forward to having you as a subscriber. And thanks for all you’re doing. Jim Ball _
__Climate activist and thinker since ‘92. ”Together we make the impossible possible and the possible actual and the actual beautiful and our future come faster.”_

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. Hi Peter,

Let’s talk about voter suppression.

Earlier this month, the SAVE Act passed the House of Representatives. **If it becomes law, it could prevent millions of American citizens from voting.**

The SAVE Act would require every American to show proof of citizenship when registering to vote. On its face, that doesn’t sound too bad, until you remember:
* Millions of Americans change their legal name when they get married, without updating their birth certificate.
* In 44 states, a Real ID does not meet the criteria for proof of citizenship.
* 3.2 million people in Wisconsin alone – more than half of our population – do not have a passport.

**In practice, if the SAVE Act were to become law, millions of Americans would be denied their Constitutional right to vote.**

Imagine all of the elderly Wisconsin voters who would be forced to track down decades-old birth certificates, navigate the bureaucracy of updating those documents, and then pay the fees necessary for new documents.

**For seniors who may be on fixed income, and for working families struggling to make ends meet, this is essentially a poll tax.**

This isn't about election security. _Wisconsin's elections are already secure._

This is about making it harder for eligible Americans to vote, plain and simple.

**Wisconsinites deserve to be able to cast their ballots without jumping through impossible hoops.**

As Governor, I’ll protect voting rights, push for nonpartisan redistricting at every level, and strengthen the systems that ensure every voice is heard—because democracy only works when it works for all of us.

clean_body: If the SAVE Act were to become law, millions of Americans would be denied their Constitutional right to vote. | | Hi Peter, Let’s talk about voter suppression. Earlier this month, the SAVE Act passed the House of Representatives. If it becomes law, it could prevent millions of American citizens from voting. The SAVE Act would require every American to show proof of citizenship when registering to vote. On its face, that doesn’t sound too bad, until you remember: Millions of Americans change their legal name when they get married, without updating their birth certificate. In 44 states, a Real ID does not meet the criteria for proof of citizenship. 3.2 million people in Wisconsin alone – more than half of our population – do not have a passport. In practice, if the SAVE Act were to become law, millions of Americans would be denied their Constitutional right to vote. Imagine all of the elderly Wisconsin voters who would be forced to track down decades-old birth certificates, navigate the bureaucracy of updating those documents, and then pay the fees necessary for new documents. For seniors who may be on fixed income, and for working families struggling to make ends meet, this is essentially a poll tax. This isn't about election security. Wisconsin's elections are already secure. This is about making it harder for eligible Americans to vote, plain and simple. Wisconsinites deserve to be able to cast their ballots without jumping through impossible hoops. As Governor, I’ll protect voting rights, push for nonpartisan redistricting at every level, and strengthen the systems that ensure every voice is heard—because democracy only works when it works for all of us. The “Greg Abbott Corruption Tax” is selling out Texans at every turn.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
For 12 years, Greg Abbott has used his power to reward his billionaire donors and political allies rather than serving Texans.
The consequence? We’re all paying the **Greg Abbott Corruption Tax.**
While Abbott gives his corporate buddies property tax breaks, _Texans can’t afford homes._ While he prioritizes profits over patients, _we can’t get quality healthcare._ And while he funnels billions into his private school voucher scam, _our neighborhood schools are being gutted._
**At every turn, Abbott has chosen corruption over Texans.**
**[Will you chip in $5 right now to help us elect a governor who works for Texans, not billionaires?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260225_3_corruption.wRFJzb&refcode=em20260225-645&amount=5&t=1&akid=645%2E299639%2EHUnKRO)**

Growing up in the Valley, my grandmother taught me a simple phrase: _"No te dejes."_ Don’t let them get away with it. Don’t let them push you around. _Fight back._
I’ve spent my career living out this mindset and pushing back against corruption in government.
I know how to beat these people. **And I know how to win.**
The polls are still showing us within 3 points of Abbott. This is doable. But first, we need to secure this nomination.
We are less than a week away from the Democratic primary on March 3, and we need all the resources we can get to finish strong and take on Abbott in November.
_Texans deserve better than a governor who has sold them out at every turn._
**[Don’t let them get away with it. Rush $5 to get Abbott out of office.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260225_3_corruption.wRFJzb&refcode=em20260225-645&amount=5&t=4&akid=645%2E299639%2EHUnKRO)**

Gina Hinojosa

body:
We can build a country where health care is affordable, where families aren’t targeted but protected, where hard work actually pays off.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260225-5944-footer&t=1&akid=5944%2E420207%2Ed9fENP)
Peter,
**Last night, Trump spewed lie after lie about how well his agenda is “working” — and I went on MSNOW after the speech to call him out:**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260225.DxOfDa&refcode=em20260225-5944&t=2&akid=5944%2E420207%2Ed9fENP)
While Trump lives in his lies, we know the real story:
🩺 Parents who can’t afford to take their sick kid to the doctor.
👪 Immigrant families living every day with the fear of being torn apart.
🪙 Working people pinching pennies while billionaires cash in.
And here’s the truth he’ll never say: **a better future is within our reach.**
We can build a country where health care is affordable, where families aren’t targeted but protected, where hard work actually pays off. A country where people can thrive – not just survive.
That’s why I’m fighting for Medicare for All. For an economy that works for the people, not just the powerful and well-connected. For dignity and justice for EVERYONE.
**Regardless of what Trump says, I'll be here tirelessly working every day, for real change.**
[**If you’re with me, chip in $3 or whatever you can to fuel our people-powered movement and keep holding Trump accountable for his lies.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260225.DxOfDa&refcode=em20260225-5944&amount=3&t=3&akid=5944%2E420207%2Ed9fENP)

Here’s the bottom line: We don’t have to accept this.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2794%2E4032634%2E92yNeU)
---
Last night he talked for 1 hour and 48 minutes. And as always, he said _**a lot**_ and somehow still nothing at all. He talked about the so-called “hoax” of affordability. He talked about the stock market and about tariffs. He claimed that America is “winning,” that we’re the “hottest country in the world,” and that everyone’s income is “way up.” He lied, exaggerated, and used fear and shame when speaking to the American people about the state of our union. And of course, he talked about himself. But as I listened, I didn’t hear one thing that actually matters to most working families. **On health care:** He kicked 15 million people off insurance, cut $800 billion from health care, and bailed out Argentina’s Wall Street investors instead. **On child care and housing:** Not a word. Yet families struggle every day to afford daycare, mortgages, and rent. **On immigration and ICE:** He tripled ICE’s budget, terrorizing communities, killing people, by cutting funding for Americans’ health care. What ICE is doing is incredibly unpopular, despite how much he boasts about it while stoking hateful rhetoric about immigrants. **On corruption:** Trump’s family crypto company has made over $1 billion this term alone. Talk about draining the swamp. **On trade:** He called the Supreme Court’s ruling about his tariffs being illegal “disappointing.” What’s “disappointing” is that he stole money out of people’s pockets by forcing families to pay more than $1,700 each on tariff price increases. He didn’t mention that part, though. Trump can spin, lie, and give himself as many standing ovations as he wants (and at 1 hour and 48 minutes, he certainly did.) to try to convince us we’re better off under his leadership. But all we have to do is look around. Groceries are more expensive. Tariffs have stolen thousands from you. Our communities are not any safer. And Trump’s family and their billionaire friends have been cashing in. **Here’s the bottom line:** We don’t have to accept this. I’m committed to using every tool I have to fight this corrupt administration — and to push the Democratic party to fight harder for working people with bold, structural economic change and a clear, forceful rebuttal to Trump’s lies and failed policies. As for you, I hope you’ll join me in holding onto the belief that better things are possible — and resolving to stay in this fight. [**Please consider making a contribution to help us fight back against Trump’s failed policies and fight FOR big, structural change for working families.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3484?t=8&akid=2794%2E4032634%2E92yNeU) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

clean_body: Here’s the bottom line: We don’t have to accept this. | | | Last night he talked for 1 hour and 48 minutes. And as always, he said a lot and somehow still nothing at all. He talked about the so-called “hoax” of affordability. He talked about the stock market and about tariffs. He claimed that America is “winning,” that we’re the “hottest country in the world,” and that everyone’s income is “way up.” He lied, exaggerated, and used fear and shame when speaking to the American people about the state of our union. And of course, he talked about himself. But as I listened, I didn’t hear one thing that actually matters to most working families. On health care: He kicked 15 million people off insurance, cut $800 billion from health care, and bailed out Argentina’s Wall Street investors instead. On child care and housing: Not a word. Yet families struggle every day to afford daycare, mortgages, and rent. On immigration and ICE: He tripled ICE’s budget, terrorizing communities, killing people, by cutting funding for Americans’ health care. What ICE is doing is incredibly unpopular, despite how much he boasts about it while stoking hateful rhetoric about immigrants. On corruption: Trump’s family crypto company has made over $1 billion this term alone. Talk about draining the swamp. On trade: He called the Supreme Court’s ruling about his tariffs being illegal “disappointing.” What’s “disappointing” is that he stole money out of people’s pockets by forcing families to pay more than $1,700 each on tariff price increases. He didn’t mention that part, though. Trump can spin, lie, and give himself as many standing ovations as he wants (and at 1 hour and 48 minutes, he certainly did.) to try to convince us we’re better off under his leadership. But all we have to do is look around. Groceries are more expensive. Tariffs have stolen thousands from you. Our communities are not any safer. And Trump’s family and their billionaire friends have been cashing in. Here’s the bottom line: We don’t have to accept this. I’m committed to using every tool I have to fight this corrupt administration — and to push the Democratic party to fight harder for working people with bold, structural economic change and a clear, forceful rebuttal to Trump’s lies and failed policies. As for you, I hope you’ll join me in holding onto the belief that better things are possible — and resolving to stay in this fight.
